Hotelservicen var bra, de var og veldig behjelplig med bordreservasjoner og privat transport til og fra flyplassen. Vil absolutt dra tilbake hit igjen. Anbefales! (Det eneste minuset, som også var nevnt i en annen anmeldelse, var at de som bodde på Towers måtte benytte to forskjellige heissett for å komme mellom rommene og club'en. Dette fremsto som litt rart ettersom det jo var Towers-gjenstene som kunne benytte cluben, men vi ble fort vant til det)

name: Trump International Hotel and Tower
title: “Not even close to being a 3 Star Hotel”
text: Arrived at 4:30 pm and our rooms were not ready. Five of us waited in the very small lobby for an hour to be given keys to a room with used soap still left in the bathroom. Overall, the blinds didn't work, hand many issues with the keys not working, a broken (CHAIR AND SOFA BED) removed and not returned until we requested a replacement 24 hours ++ wait outdated furnishings. VERY VERY VERY disappointed with this property and the services we received. Our group of five found it DIRTY and would NEVER EVER stay in another TRUMP property again. DISGUSTED

name: The London NYC
title: “My what big rooms”
text: We stayed here for one short night while in town for a convention. Our room was MUCH bigger than expected, especially for NYC. The bed was comfy and the room was super clean, the bathroom was also very roomy. They put us on the 40-something floor so the views were great. Overall this hotel was perfect. Check in and out were a breeze. Couldn't ask for a better stay. I will not hesitate to book at the London whenever I'm back in town

name: Ink48 - a Kimpton Hotel
title: “This is one outstanding hotel! It's brand...”
text: This is one outstanding hotel! It's brand new, modern, clean and it's a luxury 4 star hotel. The staff are were very friendly, helpful and accommodating. When we came the first day to check in the person at the desk upgraded us to a room that is 300 sq ft bigger than what we booked and he did that for free just because it was available. We were staying for two nights, but then the last day we decided to stay one more night, we asked the front desk if they have anything available, he checked with the manager and said that we can keep the same room that we are in for only $50 more per night. We are really happy and satisfied with our hotel choice and we will definitely try to be back here next time we come to New York. I want to also mention that the size of our room was like an apartment. Huge!!! With a king size bed and windows all around, we had two LCD screen TVs a couch, two modern sofa chairs, an ihome alarm clock. The bathroom was the size of a whole room. Just Beautiful!! We had a big bathtub with a separate shower and two sinks. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North
title: “Nice hotel, good location”
text:
This was a very nice hotel, and reasonably priced especially considering its location. The room was large, the bed was comfortable, and the service was great. Free WiFi is available in the rooms, and there is a free breakfast as well (unfortunately the coffee was undrinkable, but there is a Starbucks on the next block).
The hotel is pretty close to the theater district/Times Square, and only a few blocks from the 50th Street subway stop. 
I would definitely stay here again.

name: The London NYC
title: “The London is AWESOME”
text: We have had the pleasure of staying at The London NYC many times. The London boasts wonderful food, top notch service and great rooms, not to mention the splendid location. I can not see myself staying anywhere else while visiting New York.

name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th
title: “Loved the hotel. Friendly Service, Clean, and Quiet.”
text: Very happy with our stay here. Beds are exceptionally comfortable. Staff went out of their way to be helpful and friendly. We loved the chilled ice water with orange slices at the front desk. Very thirst quenching on a warm summery day. We'll be back, next time we are in New York.

name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th
title: “Fantastic location, fantastic hotel!”
text: What a fantastic hotel to base yourself in while staying in Manhattan. Centrally located around the corner from Macy’s and the Empire state building, and being a short distance to Times Square, staying in the Garden Inn really allowed me to explore the city at my leisure. It was virtually impossible to get lost when the hotel was so easy to find! The staff were exceptionally helpful, friendly and welcoming, and the reasonably priced breakfast was a great way to start a day of sightseeing or shopping. A hotel I couldn’t find fault with and would highly recommend!

name: Four Seasons Hotel Los Angeles at Beverly Hills
title: “Amazing service!”
text: My husband and I stayed here for 3 nights recently. We loved the four seasons. Great location, close to shopping and restaurants. Valet guys were great and always offered us water for our trip. Every request we made was handled quickly. We stayed in a deluxe executive suite on the 11th floor and the view was amazing, could see the Hollywood sign in the distance. Concierge was very helpful and the bed was outrageously comfortable. The rooms are not the fanciest or the most stylish but it's really the service that makes this hotel!

name: The Jewel Facing Rockefeller Center
title: “Feliz de haberlo escogido!”
text: Fui con mi esposo este verano, elegimos el hotel en gran parte por las criticas encontradas en este sitio, y estamos felices!!! El hotel es nuevecito, pequeño, pero supongo que así son todos en Nueva York. Ubicación increible, fente al rockefeller center. Las habitaciones pequeñitas pero llenas de detalles tecnologicos. El ipod dock, las conecciones usb, la televisión... todo me pareció muy bien. La puerta del baño no se puede asegurar, por si a alguien le importa eso. Tiene en el segundo piso un area donde puedes hacer uso de Internet gratuito e imprimir boletos de avion, confirmaciones o lo que te haga falta. Hay agua fria en todos los pisos, así que puedes tomar tu botellita y llevarla cuando sales de paseo. Me quede con las ganas de conocer el restaurante pero ¿a que hora!? Tuvimos una falsa alarma de incendios que nos despertó a las 6 de la mañana. La unica queja que tengo es sobre las sábanas: Son de poliester y súper resbalosas, se deslizan y cuando despiertas ya están el suelo. Si conserva los precios súper accesibles que tenia este 2011, seguro regresaré.

name: Hilton Times Square
title: “Fantastic stay!”
text: We were in NYC for the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade and stayed at the Hilton Times Square. The location was great- we were able to walk to almost everything we wanted to do. The staff was wonderful; everyone was very helpful and friendly. We arrived early, and were able to check in early which was an unexpected surprise considering we arrived the day before Thanksgiving. We were also pleasantly surprised by the size of the hotel room, much larger than I anticipated for Manhattan, and enjoyed having 2 queen beds rather than double beds. The room was clean, and it was quiet! After staying at other Manahttan hotels on previous visits, I was so happy to be far above the traffic noise!! Best of all was not feeling like we paid and arm and a leg for a nice hotel in Manhattan.

name: The London NYC
title: “Hip, Love the Suites”
text: Just a great hotel. Location in the 50's good-the concierge excellent. The doorman the same wonderful helpful, will get me that taxi still there since my last stay a year or two ago. Afternoon tea service good. Bed comfy and like the suite option. Stayed with a friend for a girls day in nyc and worked perfectly.

name: Hilton Garden Inn Times Square
title: “Great Hotel and Location”
text: I stayed at the Hilton Garden Inn Times Square over Christmas 2006. The stay was perfect. The room, the price, the service, and the location were all excellent. We were walking distance to Times Square and all the Broadway shows and Rockefeller Center. The room was larger than I expected, and the bed was very comfortable. The staff were friendly and helpful. We had some family members who played violin in the lobby one night, and no one had a problem with us gathering around and making so much "noise". The attached french-style restaurant was good for breakfast. I would definitely stay there again.

name: Four Seasons Hotel Los Angeles at Beverly Hills
title: “Awesome Location, Great Staff!”
text:
Labor Day Weekend Getaway! The Four Season is in a AWESOME location minutes from everything.
Upon arriving I decided to use Concierge and get additional information. I spoke to Michelle, Professional but had to call twice and get the restaurant recommendations via email. 
Upon arriving you are greeted by several valet staff and manger, only to find another door greeter opening the door and welcoming you to Four Seasons Hotel. The hotel is tastefully decorated, filled with wonderful arrays of fresh flowers, plants and landscaping is well manicured 
The guest service agent who checked us in was EXTREMELY professional and welcoming and took the additional step of coming out to shake my hand and showed me the elevator. In addition she also updated my profile for my personal request.
The hallway which leads you to the room was clean from Room Service Trays. The room was refreshing, elegantly appointed and great views of the City to include a clean balcony. The room was clean and serviced well, the bathrooms had all the necessary amenities needed and if you forgot something you could order the items directly on the ipad that was provided. Make sure to get your shoe shined! I love the amenity.
The car service is perfect and very accommodating, we used this service throughout our stay. Make sure to have a night cap in the bar it's an awesome way to end a perfect evening.
The Bad:
Turn down service was great but not perfect, I expected the bed to be turned down which it was not. Not sure if this was the brand service for this location. Used glasses and trays was not removed for the room, so we has dirty glasses for the next two nights. Bathroom amenities was not replenished. Housekeeping did a GREAT job in cleaning the room.
When ordering ice cream I would expect to get a spoon but I had to go to the bartender so that the server could bring back a spoon.
Adjoining door needs additional insulation. I heard our neighbor at 6AM talking.
Aside from these MINOR issues I would of provided a 5 star. We will come back and enjoy the service of a GREAT hotel.

name: Hilton Garden Inn Times Square
title: “Great hotel!”
text:
I really loved this hotel! The rooms were spacious and clean. The beds were made every day. It has all the amenities you need.
The only cons are: there was a woman at the front desk when we checked in called Melinda, she was sucking on an allegedly "extremely sour" candy and we couldn't understand a single word she was saying. We caught words such as "breakfast", "buisness" and "free cookies", but nothing more than that.
They charged us 500 dollars more than what they should have for the complete stay at the end, but they did of course correct themselves and took away two telephone calls costs which was good.
Anyway, the rooms were so awesome! You should definitely come here. The service was really horrible though. It took us an hour to get hold of our luggage to check out, and whenever said they were sorry about something they couldn't be more false about it and they didn't even look at you. The only person that smiled to us was Melinda.

name: The New York Palace Hotel
title: “The New York Palace -perfeita estadia em Manhattan”
text: O hotel é muito luxuoso, o staff super atencioso e a localização não poderia ser melhor. Nosso quarto tinha uma vista maravilhosa para a Catedral de Saint Patrick. Há um único inconveniente: o frigobar possui sensores para cobrar automaticamente o consumo, então não se pode tocar em nada que não se consuma!!

name: Four Seasons Hotel Los Angeles at Beverly Hills
title: “Staff and service are top notch!”
text: My husband and I recently attended an event at the Hollywood Bowl and were looking to stay at a hotel within close proximity to the concert. We chose this particular hotel based on the positive reviews on Trip Advisor. We were treated like royalty by staff and management. I highly recommend this hotel.

name: The London NYC
title: “Great Hotel - wouldn't know it had over 500 rooms!!”
text: Had a wonderful experience here recently. Stayed for only 2 nights, but all my "urgent" needs during this trip were handled by the staff perfectly! The lobby bar/restaurant is a great meet up place and the bartenders were very friendly. Got a few great drink recommendations and will definitely stay here again in the future.

name: Affinia Dumont
title: “Unbelievably large rooms”
text: I was shocked when I saw the size of the room. Seriously huge for NY hotel room standards. I had a very good stay. The room was very large, with "two" closets, and a kitchen! Everything was clean. There was a problem with the air-conditioner, but a maintenance staff was sent to work on the problem as soon as we informed the front desk. The toiletries were from Aveda, which I thought was a nice bonus. The staff at the front desk were slow but otherwise everything was great. I don't think too many people will use the kitchen but in case anyone is interested, there's a small convenient store on the right side of the hotel.

name: YOTEL New York at Times Square West
title: “A due passi da Times Square, camere piccole ma pulite e molto tecnologiche e confortevoli. Ottimo per soggiorni brevi a budget r”
text:
Questo hotel vicinissimo a Times Square offre tutto quello di cui avete bisogno in spazi ridottissimi e a prezzi ottimi. La camera è veramente piccola ma non manca nulla. Un bel televisore enorme, la doccia di dimensioni abbastanza grandi e un letto confortevole. Unica pecca l'aria condizionata di non semplice utilizzo, per me. Offrono caffè o the e un muffin a colazione e in ogni piano c'è una postazione con una macchinetta per il caffè Lavazza e l'acqua sempre gratuiti. 
C'è una bella terrazza con bar che non abbiamo utilizzato se non per la colazione e una hall al quarto piano con vari salottini. All'ingresso si sente un forte profumo caratteristico e piacevole. Consigliato !!

name: The Jewel Facing Rockefeller Center
title: “Sehr zu empfehlen”
text:
Ich habe das Hotel wegen seiner zentralen Lage und der modernen Ausstattung gebucht und bin nicht enttäuscht worden. Bei Außentemperaturen von über 30°C kam auch die kostenlose Wasserabfüllanlage im Hotel sehr gelegen.
Nett ist auch der kostenlose Internetzugang.

name: The London NYC
title: “Why stay anywhere else?”
text:
Just back from great Girls stay at the London . The location , service, spotless rooms and friendly and helpful staff made it a pleasure to stay there. Although there were 7 in our party the Concierge managed to get us into every restaurant we requested and were able to supply answers to our many queries. The London manages to be welcoming and classy without being pretentious and our four 18 years olds were made to feel very welcome.
Can think of no reason to stay anywhere else in NY. We will be back!

name: Four Seasons Hotel Los Angeles at Beverly Hills
title: “Service, Service, Service.”
text:
The old adage of “location, location, location” when it comes to property is somewhat valid when it comes to hotels, and The Four Seasons at Beverly Hills certainly is well located, but I believe the best description for this hotel is “service, service, service”
We have stayed at a few Four Seasons properties before, including Cairo and Sydney, and the major differentiator between the Four Seasons brand and other 5-star chains is the great level of service. The Beverly Hills property is no different. We were very happy with the treatment we received. From the Valet team, who are excellent and treated us as well as the stars they service, [we waited for our car one evening beside Liam Neeson who had been at the hotel doing a Press junket], to the Concierge and Front Desk staff. Could not fault a single experience with any of the staff.
We stayed in a Deluxe Executive Suite which was a little on the small side with two adults and two children, but had great views of the Hollywood sign from the balcony. Very nice touch of personalized cupcakes in the room for the kids when we checked in. Room is functional and clean and understated in its décor. There are much flashier places to stay, but we very much enjoyed our time in the hotel.
We made use of the pool even though the outside temperature was fairly cool. The Sunday brunch at Culina was good, and I feel very reasonably priced compared to other similar spreads in other countries. Even though we had a rental vehicle, we made use of the hotel car, [a Rolls Royce Ghost], to take us to dinner on Beverly Blvd one evening. They also arranged a very nice limo to take us to a Lakers game.
We will definitely be staying at this hotel again and it’s our new first choice hotel when visiting Los Angeles. I would have no hesitation in recommending it to family and friends.

name: Affinia Dumont
title: “Affinia Dumont is wonderful.”
text: We just returned from NYC. The Affinia Dumont turned out to be a very pleasant experience. We go to NYC fairly often, and this is my favorite of the seven or so hotels we've tried over the last six months. The entire staff was most friendly, helpful and energetic. Our room was enormous by NYC standards. Having a kitchen was great. We were on the 35th floor with a spectacular view (especially of the Chrysler building- a wonderful sight at night). My husband and I are walkers, and found the location to be quite a good base for exploring several NY neighborhoods. We'll definitely be back.

name: The London NYC
title: “Always Top Quality”
text: Upon the glowing recommendations of many friends who have stayed at The London, we recently spent a wonderful weekend there. The service, location, accommodations, and atmosphere are second-to-none. This is our new favorite hotel and we will definitely stay here again.

name: Trump International Hotel and Tower
title: “Veramente unico”
text:
Ho avuto l'occasione di soggiornare per una settimana in questo hotel con mia moglie e ciò ha reso la vacanza a NY indimenticabile.La camera spaziosa completa di tutti i comfort compreso un angolo cottura biancheria eccezzionale vista Central Parc pulizia e gentilezza dello staff completano il resto.
Il prezzo considerando l'altissima qualità è da considerare giusto.

name: Affinia Dumont
title: “Excellent - highly recommended”
text: Spent 5 nights here in late April, early May 2006. Staff was very friendly and helpful. Clean, nice rooms. I guess I was especially lucky with my corner room (suite?) on the 26th floor. Nice view, handy kitchen (make your own coffee!), great work desk, Internet connection, nice bathroom, etc. A colleague had a smoker's room on the 23rd floor. Not as big or nice as mine, but still very good. Several nice bars and restaurants nearby. Great location, 5 minutes walk from the Empire State Building. 15 minutes or so to Times Square. Will definitely stay here again. Highly recommended.

name: Four Seasons Hotel Los Angeles at Beverly Hills
title: “worst 5 star hotel ever”
text:
At check in my debit card was charged $1367 for no particular reason since my hotel was already paid for. I was told after the fact that it is a hotel policy to have a $300 safety deposit for the room. This still doesn't explain the $1367 charge. It will take up to 10 business days for a refund. 
The room was small and very unimpressive. The beds were small and uncomfortable. The headboard design was like in a dorm.
When I spoke to the assistant hotel manager about all the issues, she was very patronizing and gave me a one night valet refund ...

name: The New York Palace Hotel
title: “New York”
text:
The Palace is een prachtig en vooral fijn Hotel om te verblijven,
je hoeft niets te doen ,ze helpen je met alles .
Kamer is groot en er ontbreekt niets ,bedden zijn heerlijk mooie badkamer etc
niets is stuk of oud.
het enige nadeel is maar dat hebben alle hotels ontbijt is wat prijzig ,in de buurt zijn er genoeg diners om goedkoop en leuk te ontbijten.
Veel plezier in de Big Apple.

name: Hilton Garden Inn Times Square
title: “We enjoyed every minute of NYC!”
text: My husband and I stayed in New York for 10 days to celebrate our 10th anniversary. We love the hotel -- great location, comfortable king-sized bed, great view from the 14th floor. The room was quiet, never heard a peep from anyone else on the floor. We walked everywhere or took the subway which was close by. We really liked the restaurants in nearby Hell's Kitchen. Having wireless internet was great as we uploaded digital photos every day after sightseeing. We'll probably stay here again in a few years when we bring our daughters to NY.

name: The New York Palace Hotel
title: “New York Palace - flott hotell, kanskje for flott?”
text:
Vi bodde på New York Palace og har kun positivt å si om hotellstandard, mottakelse og betjening. Personalet var vennlige og rengjøringen god. Vi fikk også et fint rom med flott utsikt over Madison avenue og St. Patricks Cathedral.
Men for oss som var på ferie, var det er stort minus at det manglet både kjøleskap på rommet og utstyr til å koke kaffe/te. Rommet av utstyrt med automatisk minibar, men dette kjøleskapet var ikke stort nok til at man kunne legge inn eget vann etc.
Frokosten på hotellet, som vi kjøpte en dag, var helt grei, men til den prisen fikk vi mye mer for pengene utenfor hotellet.
Beliggenheten er fin ved Rockefeller center, og nært til det meste midt på Manhattan. Vi brukte ca 10 minutter på å gå til Times Square.

name: YOTEL New York at Times Square West
title: “Un des meilleurs a New York”
text:
L'hôtel est très bien situé à deux pas de la station de bus et de Métro de Port Authority.
Les chambres sont petites et très biens concues. Le lit rétractable est une très bonne idée et permet un gain de place dans la chambre et c'est aussi très pratique pour regarder la TV.
La salle de bain donne sur une grande baie vitrée ce qui offre une très belle vue en prenant sa douche.
Nous avons aimés également la salle disponible sur chaque étage pour se faire un café du thé,un chocolat chaud, capuccino ou de l'eau fraiche sans sup et le petit déjeuner avec les muffins à volonté.Nous avons aussi aimé l'accès à internet gratuit à l'hôtel et le check in et check out quasi automatique qui prend 30 sec.
Le seul hic à nos yeux l'absence de porte entre la partie salle de bain et la partie chambre ce qui réduit l'intimité.

name: The New York Palace Hotel
title: “Mitten im Big Apple”
text:
Ich war das 10 Mal im New York Palace. Vor 15 Jahren das 1. Mal- damals war es frisch renoviert. Es gab einen Piano-Player im Foyer-alles war sehr edel. Auch an diesem Hotel hat der Zahn der Zeit genagt. Das Piano ist erschwunden, die Zimmer wirken nicht mehr so frisch, im Bad gibt es ein paar Schmuddelecken.
Wenn wir als Geschäftsreisende über die Firma gebucht haben,waren die Zimmer von Anfang an in Ordnung. Bei der Buchung über expedia bekommt man am Anfang eindeutig schlecht gelegene,laute Zimmer. Bei Beschwerde wird aber sofort und souverän reagiert.
Ich würde aber nach wie vor in das New York Palace gehen ,da die Lage, das Preis-Leistungs Verhältnis, die Atmosphäre im Foyer, die Größe der Zimmer (eindeutig hervorstechend für New Yorker Hotels),der Service stimmen.

name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th
title: “Perfect - Exceeded Our Expectations!”
text: The location was absolutely perfect and the price was fabulous. We have visited the City numerous times but have never stayed. This, being our first overnight vist was a great experience, sure to be repeated. Check in was quick and easy with cheerful and helpful staff. Our room was perfect - clean- neat- and comfrontable. Great having wireless in the room. Having a fridge and microwave in the room was a saver for sure. I had reviewed the Hilton Garden Inn prior to our visit and folks were right on with their fine reviews. We stayed two nights and filled those days and nights with as much fun as we could; visiting Rockerfeller Ctn, Times Sq, Central Park and St Patricks. All on foot and we enjoyed it. The Empire State Bldg was within "arms" reach. A very short walk to Penn Station and easy to find our train home. Will be sure to book the Hilton Garden Inn on 35th St again when we hope to be able to stay longer. NYC was friendly - the Hilton was great.

name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Hospitality House
title: “Fantastic value, space and location”
text:
A balanced review.
Hospitality House is in a great location in Midtown East close to restaurants, shops, the subway, the United Nations and a wide range of museums and other great venues.
The hotel is an old apartment block where the foyer is being renovated so you have to walk through the building works to get in and out of your apartment, but that's okay.
Three of us stayed for two weeks in a huge 2 bedroom apartment with a full kitchen and bathroom, breakfast incuded daily (or get extra supplies at Azure deli in 3rd Ave and great coffee in the place directly opposite the hotel) and daily housekeeping. Sure the plumbing can fail to proceed (for us it was the dishwasher but the response to our requests for assistance were exemplary). the traffic is noisy and the A/C is loud but his is NYC so wear ear plugs. The apartments are old and the furnishings okay and clean - nothing 'flash' but fabulous given the locaton and the price.
For location and range and size of facilities the place is 'a steal'. If you expect the Ritz or Waldorf, I suggest you stay there. My friends and I would stay at Hospitality House if we return to New York.

name: Hilton Garden Inn Times Square
title: “GREAT!”
text: I spent one night at the Hilton Garden Inn in Times Square, and wished I could of had several more. The room was QUIET! CLEAN! and COMFY!!!!!!! We were right in Times Square , the theater district and walkable to everything. The beds were covered with these super comfortors and I never wanted to get out of bed. There is a free breakfast at the restaurant downstairs to hotel guests. It was large and varied. I would highly recommend it to folks, it's on my list of where to stay next time I am in NYC.

name: The New York Palace Hotel
title: “New York Palace”
text:
Très agréable, trés bien situé. Notre chambres était spacieuse et bien située.
Attitude tres pro du staff, cependant un peu détachée. Wifi dans la chambre est à un prix exorbitant et dissuasif. Petit déjeuner et room service très chers mais cela est malheureusement le cas de tous les hotels de cette catégorie à NYC (idem pour le Wifi).
A recommander

name: Trump International Hotel and Tower
title: “Top Hotel in excellenter Lage”
text: Excellentes Hotel in super Lage, Central Park und U-Bahn vor der Tür. Wir waren als Familie (2 Kinder 12+10) in einer schönen Suit, sehr geräumig, sauber, voll eingerichtete Küche. Bio Supermarkt im shopping centre next door. Cafe's+ restaurants um die Ecke für jeden Geschmack. Gefallen hat das Ao Caffe am Columbus Square zum Frühstücken.

name: Sanctuary Hotel New York
title: “Ticks all the boxes (except maybe breakfast)”
text:
I have read a lot of the reviews for The Sanctuary on this site, mainly as a result of it being the default home page for the wifi connection at the hotel.
My run down is as follows;
1. The reviews about the staff being friendly and very helpful is correct. They are not intrusive, and it's the first time I've stayed in a hotel where the front desk knew my name before I even checked in. 
2. Yes, the rooms are smallish. But then again, I've paid a lot more for a lot less to stay in the centre of London. 
3. Breakfast is nothing to write home about. Cheap and cheerful I guess. With so many food options in NYC, I didn't even bother with the breaky here. 
4. Location is spot on. Walking distance from pretty much everything. The staff give you good guidance before you set off as well. 
5. Rooftop bar is really chic. Great service, fantastic view. It's low set, so you don't get a sweeping panoramic view, but the lighting is terrific and the surrounding views are still great. 
6. The hotel doesn't have a gym. As an avid gym user, I was very impressed that the hotel has an arrangement with an Equinox gym which is about a 5 minute walk from the hotel. It is a full gym, and in my view, this is so much better than just having a standard hotel gym, which to be honest, are usually terrible. So if you consider gyms when booking a hotel, it is definitely worth the 5 minute walk. However, the hotel does need to sort out the process. I went twice to the gym, and the hotel told me I didn't need a pass to attend, just my ID, hotel room card and hotel business card. Twice the gym told me I needed a pass. But other than that, having access to a proper gymnasium was superb. 
7. The room I was in was surprisingly quiet considering location, so I managed to sleep well without being disturbed.
In my view, the access to the gym, the location and the price far outweigh having an average breakfast considering there are so many places to eat in the area, and as a tourist, I wasn't looking for a hotel breakfast.
Overall, I would book this hotel again if I was staying in Times Square. My friend was staying at the W Hotel just nearby (maybe 200m), and he paid more for what I considered a comparable room, minus the service and friendliness.

name: Sanctuary Hotel New York
title: “Great Experience”
text: This was my first trip to New York and I am so glad we chose this hotel. The entire staff was so friendly and helpful. They always gave us great directions and tips on where to eat or shop in each neighborhood. The hotel is beautiful and also very clean. Our room was very comfortable and it was great to have the complimentary breakfast right downstairs. I would definitely stay here again.

name: YOTEL New York at Times Square West
title: “EXCELENTE SITUACION Y RELACION CALIDAD-PRECIO”
text: En el actualmente carísimo Nueva York, y si no hay posibilidad de alquilar una apartamento entre varios, ésta es posiblemente una excelente opción para una pareja. No lo puedo recomendar para compartir habitación si no hay mucha intimidad, pues el baño carece totalmente de ella. El mínimo espacio de la habitación es ya una constante en la gran manzana, y te puede ocurrir hasta en el Hilton, el cual cuesta el triple que el Yotel. Este defecto se ve compensado por la modernísima cama doble, que pulsando un botón trepa por la pared, convirtiéndose en un sofá ancho. En una ciudad cuyos hoteles, además de caros, no incluyen el desayuno, es muy de agradecer la gratuidad de las infusiones y las magdalenas de todos los sabores imaginables. Además, cada planta cuenta con una cocinita con nevera, hielera y máquina de café gratuita las 24 horas (recomiendo el chocolate, yumm). El restaurante es malo y caro, pero el Yotel esta muy cerca del cruce de la calle 46 con la Novena y Octava Avenidas, ( the Restaurants Row ) donde hay cientos de restaurantes de todas las especialidades y precios ( los de la cercana Times Square son mucho más caros). Por cierto, en la misma 46 os recomiendo el Bourbon Street, de arquitectura y cocina Nueva Orleans, bueno, bonito y relativamente barato, aprovechad la happy hour ! Justo enfrente de este restaurante está el "Don,t tell mamma", bar musical donde todos los camareros cantan temas de Broadway.

name: Doubletree Guest Suites Times Square
title: “Location , location !”
text: We stayed 5 nights in a suite on the upper floors of the hotel . Very spacious (living area , bedroom , 2 bathrooms )for New York and at a reasonable price . Service is excellent and the whole staff is friendly , helpfull and attentive. Definitely we will go back again in the near future !

name: Days Inn and Suites Houston Hobby Airport
title: “The Owner Or Manager I Don't Which (Awesome)”
text:
This gentlemen love his business and career.
This Hotel is wonderful I really enjoyed my stay and im going back for four more nights wouldn't stay any where else and get this im a Gold Platum Member next door i could actually stay for free at the Choice Hotel but i choose to stay here Days Inn. Now what does that say, a lot. Thank You.
Stephanie Hill 
New Member

name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th
title: “EXCELLENT”
text: I have to say this was one of the best hotels I have ever stayed in and would definitely would stay again. Bed was fantastic and the room was functionable even though it was small! Never ate at the hotel but there are many options right beside of the hotel. Concierge service was very friendly and honest. Our view was fantastic, 26th floor Cityview of the Empire State Building and Macy's. If you are a Sex and The City fan go on the tour! There are a few Cons though: The elevator takes forever and it stops on all floors. I ordered take out one day while I was getting ready and I had to go to the lobby to get it and it took almost 10 mins. for me to get there.

name: The London NYC
title: “Tired”
text:
When reading the other recent reviews of The London, I feel a bit bah humbug; am I too fussy? I don't know, but i didn't particularly enjoy my stay at the London.
Pros:
We were on a nice high floor, so nice and quiet.
The rooms/ suite we were assigned worked really well for us as a family of four - they weren't interconnecting as such, but could be closed off from the rest of the hallway.
Beds very comfortable, bathrooms well appointed, but for some reason the bathroom in our suite was tiny, yet the bathroom in the kids room much bigger.....
The rooms are really big by newnyork standards and this is a real bonus
Fabulous position uptown for site seeing
Cons:
The bedroom decor is looking tired and definitely due for an upgrade - the colors look tired and I didn't like the floorboards in the bedrooms - maybe it was just because it's winter, but the scheme in the bedrooms just looked cold and unwelcoming.
We were there for Xmas - we have been overseas every Xmas for the last couple of years, and every hotel we have stayed in has put a lovely Xmas treat in the room - Xmas cookies in Vienna, stollen in Prague, chocolates in New Delhi...... You get the drift. But the London? Nothing - you wouldn't have even known it was Xmas, and this is New York!!! It's a little thing, but it is part of what makes the trip fun for the kids.
We arrived around 10pm our first night, so availed ourselves of room service - the food was seriously average for a hotel of this standard, particularly as the menu cites Gordon Ramsey's name!! 
I awoke at 5 the next morning violently ill and was so for the next 12 hours. We thought at the time it was food poisoning; however 2 days later my daughter was similarly unwell, so it must have been a virus; however, although the hotel staff were very aware that my daughter was unwell, as we had to call a doctor and then had to stay an extra night as she was not well enough to travel, no-one even called us to ask if things were ok, or if there was anything they could do to help us........ Really disappointing.
The breakfast room staff were completely disorganized, with long waits for tables to be cleaned and prepared. They were slow to replenish buffet- again, queue of people awaiting bagels, bread etc.
We ate in maize one night - the food was good, but definitely not Gordon Ramsey standard - a poor imitation..... Sadly the bar menu is the same as the room service menu, so when we had decided to eat there late one night, my kids took one look at it, remembered our first night experience and refused to eat it!!!!!!
All in all, the London was fine - but I probably would choose a different hotel the next time I stay in new York - infact we did. We are currently staying at The Surrey!!

name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th
title: “perfect Thanskgiving weekend location!”
text: The hotel did not disappoint for our first trip to the Macy's Thanksgiving Day parade. The location was ideal and our room (2301) even had a parade route (side) view. Be warned, however, you will hear the marching bands practicing very early morning on Thanksgiving eve. Macy's is just steps from the front door, Lord & Taylor less than four blocks, making Black Friday shopping a breeze if you plan to stay over. Even if staying here other times of year, we found the hotel to be well situated, with the subway SO CLOSE or a $10 taxi fare (tip included) all it takes to easily get just about anywhere. The room itself (2301) was huge by NY standards, very clean, great hot water pressure in the shower and we liked having a window we could open. We booked directly with Hilton and were glad we did when later we found the rate on their website had dropped considerably from the time we booked. It was up to the hotel whether to make a rate change for us, and while it took some doing, we found when we reached the manager he was very accommodating. We will definitely stay here again!

name: Doubletree Guest Suites Times Square
title: “Outstanding”
text:
This is my second stay at NYC and this time around is with my family (family of 4). I wanted to stay close to Times Square. After lots of research, I decided on this hotel - seems to have good reviews and in Times Square (opposite TKTS office). 
I did not notice this hotel in my last trip and could not visualise where it was. Upon arrival (taxi), it is corner of 47th and Broadway. There is a revolving door and swing door and the hotel lobby is on the 3rd floor. There is a security check in the evening to ensure only hotel guests are allowed in. Checkin was a breeze and we were greeted by warm choc-chip cookies - YUM!!!
The room is the biggest of all compared to the other 4 places we stayed during the trip. It is a spacious one bed room apartment with a separate lounge as per hotel photos. It is great for families. There are even 2x bathroom basins!!!
Summary:
- Excellent location - right in the heart of Times Square with lots around
- Coffee/tea making facilities
- In-room microwave, fridge
- Room is clean
- Bed is comfortable
- Free WiFi is available in the hotel lobby
- TV channel with suggested things to do (not that we used it)

name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Hospitality House
title: “Wonderful place”
text: I and 4 friends spent 4 nights at the BW Hospitality House. We weren't sure if it would be as good as the other reviews promised, but it was. It is very near the Waldorf Astoria, about one block away, at 49th and Lexington. We had the penthouse level. It was clean, freshly painted, remodeled. There were 2 separate bedrooms, two full baths, a living room, dining area, separate kitchen with full sized appliances. The penthouse had a walkout roof top patio that wrapped the room. We didn't spend much time out there as it was January, but it was a neat view - up to other high rises. The beds were very comfortable, firm matresses withpillowtops for comfort. Continental breakfast was nothing fancy, Lenders bagels, oj, milk, coffee, cereal, fresh fruit but they kept it replenished. They changed the towels daily, and gave maid service. It was definitely spacious. The elevator was prompt and the front desk people were helpful. The lobby is really just a desk area. It seems more like apartments than hotel. I was very pleased and would recommend it to anyone who needs a bit of space. It cost us about $80/person/night after you add in all the taxes, which I thought was pretty good for the space we got and the quality of the accomodations. We could walk to Rockefeller Center in less than 5 minutes, and shopping on 5th Ave in about the same. The subway was about 4-5 blocks up and another subway for cross town was another 4 blocks.

name: Sanctuary Hotel New York
title: “The name doesn't lie”
text:
I stayed at the Sanctuary for a weekend getaway with friends. The hotel was situated perfectly between Times Square and the Rockefeller Center. The outside of the hotel was very distinguished with columns and a polite doorman. The reception staff was impeccably professional and absolutely willing to do everything possible to make our stay enjoyable.
The rooms had extremely comfortable beds, a desk area, and very modern bathrooms with everything you need. The bar area downstairs, along with the coffee bar, were very relaxing with helpful staff. The hotel is so quiet and seductively warm and dark that it truly is a sanctuary from whatever's going on in the city.
The breakfast was FREE and delicious - fresh squeezed orange juice, pastries, bagels, english muffins, whole fruit, cereal, hard-boiled eggs. The concierge staff was spot-on with acquiring taxis for our group and making dinner reservations for us. I cannot say enough about how satisfying our hotel stay was and how much I recommend it. You will absolutely get your money's worth and will truly appreciate this sanctuary in the city.

name: Hilton Garden Inn Times Square
title: “La mejor ubicación de NYC "el centro del mundo"”
text:
El hotel esta en el centro de Times Square en medio de toda la movida, para tomar el Metro en el misma cuadra, zona de teatros Broadway, Central Parck a 5 minutos.
El hotel es muy agradable las habitaciones son muy cómodas y las camas super Grande y la vista es inmejorable, el GYM esta muy bien y las maquinas son muy buenas, el desayunador es muy cómodo pero ojo caro como en todos los hoteles de 5 estrellas no baja de 30 pesos por persona, tienen al frente un starbucks y es mucho mas barato.
Algo importante tenes WIFI sin cargo en el Loby del Hotel y es muy rápido la coneccion 
El personal muy atento y tenes que pedir alguien que hable españiol y al instante aparece una persona muy amable.
Sin dudar es una muy buena oportunidad para alojarse en un buen hotel y en la mejor Ubicación

name: Ink48 - a Kimpton Hotel
title: “InkHotel”
text:
Hôtel récent donc propre et net .
Pas trop surdesigné (pardon pour le néologisme) donc respirable.
Un seul batiment haut proche donc une vue bien dégagé dans les chambres tant du côté rivière que du côté ville.
Environ clairement destiné à être gentrifié mais encore industrieux donc peu de restaurant.
Cependant Times Square est à 15 minutes à pied pour les amateurs du genre

name: YOTEL New York at Times Square West
title: “Moderno y cerca de todo”
text:
La concepción del hotel es muy moderna. Tanto el check in como el check out es gestionado por uno mismo y siempre hay personal para asistencia si uno tiene algún inconveniente. 
Las habitaciones son pequeñas pero comodas, especialmente la cama que es regulable si uno quiere dormir, leer o mirar la tv. El baño muy moderno y bien diseñado casi integrado con la habitación. Si tienen muchas valijas deben ver la mejor forma de acomodarlas ya que no hay placard, si unos cajones y donde colgar cosas y apoyar la valija.
La acustica es muy buena por que no se escucha nada de la calle ni de otras habitaciones.
Es muy limpio. Ofrecen un desayuno que consisten en te o café y muffins, que son ricos pero al tercer día te cansas un poco, hay también una opción de desayuno la carta. Tienen un restaurant y un bar pero cierrar un poco temprano, nosotros estamos acostumbrados a cenar tarde y si bien parecía bueno no pudimos aprovecharlo.
En cada piso hay un cuarto con cafetera, agua caliente para hacer un té, microondas y heladera. Utilizamos bastante este servicio.
También tienes WIFI incluido. 
La ubicación es muy buena. 
Nos hospedamos 7 noches y quedamos muy conformes.

name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North
title: “We love this Hotel”
text:
Great locatiion!!! Close to Broadway plays. Free Coffee and Hot Chocolate 24 hours a day. We've stayed at this property for 6 years in a row in December. The staff is friendly and helpful in finding your way around New York. Mary is great at the Concierge Desk. Frank, Rooms Manager has been very helpful for some special things. Very approachable. Rebecca was the best room attendant. Our friends got the flu and she came in to clean the room anyway. Rooms are bigger than most Hotel rooms in New York. Looking forward to our next stay in December 2012.
Mike and Peggy Gaertig

name: Hilton Garden Inn Times Square
title: “Einfach Top”
text:
Die Lage des Hotels ist unschlagbar! In den Seitengassen sind die verschiedensten Theater, da der Broadway die parallel Straße zur 8th Av. ist.
Beim Einchecken wurden wir unglaublich freundlich empfangen. Beim Auschecken ist es überhaupt kein Problem die Koffer noch dort zulassen
Die Zimmer sind schön und sauber, es gibt eine Mikrowelle, einen Kühlschrank und eine Filterkaffeemaschine falls man sich selbst versorgen möchte auf den Zimmern.
In der Früh gibt es Kaffee und am Nachmittag Cookies zur freien entnahme in der Lobby.
Bei den Matratzen der Betten kann man die Härte selbst bestimmen, das ist wirklich toll!
Das Hotel liegt direkt an der Ubahn welche man untertags leicht hören kann, aber in der Nacht ist es ruhig. Da Wir Untertags nie im Hotel waren, New York ist viel zu interessant um im Hotel zu sein, haben wir davon nur am Anreisetag etwas mitbekommen.
Ich kann dieses Hotel nur wärmstens weiterempfehlen!!

name: The London NYC
title: “Consistently Great!”
text: Have just returned once again from and enjoyable stay at The London NYC. This is about my 8th time at this property (twice a year) and the bell staff always remembers and greats me on arrival. The front desk manager takes extra care to assign me my favorite room, which makes me feel like home. The smaller size of this property gives it an inimate feel, great bedding for comfort, wonderful gym and lively but elegant bar off lobby, in which to meet friends or clients before heading to several great neighborhood restaurants. The complimentary house car takes me to my nearby meetings and makes my morning commute a joy! I would highly recoomend this property to business professional or couples looking for an upscale stay.

name: Doubletree Guest Suites Times Square
title: “Perfect!”
text: Our family of 4 stayed in NYC for 2 nights at the Doubletree Suites, and I can't wait to go again! The location is perfect...walking distance to almost all of our destinations. We took the subway, which was only a few blocks from the hotel, to Battery Park and the 9/11 Memorial. The room was immaculate. We used Hilton points, and were able to upgrade to the Conference Suite, for a small fee. The extra large room was great, the views were incredible, and it had 2 full bathrooms! The staff was very friendly and helpful. We were riding the hotel elevator with a staff member. He asked us where we were headed--we were going to dinner for pizza, but didn't know where. He recommended a place, John's Pizzeria, just a few blocks away. We went there, and it was amazing! Our room's refrigerator and microwave were handy for the leftovers. I would not want to stay at any other hotel in NY--our first trip to the city, and we were spoiled with the best!

name: The Surrey
title: “From South Surrey BC to The Surrey with love”
text: My Wife and I just got back from five nights wonderful night. What a great I original saw the advertisement for The Surrey on TheEEStory.com. Since living in South Surrey, British Columbia, I thought it would be fun and ironic to go stay at “The Surrey Hotel” My wife was also having a significant birthday and always wanted to go to New York. The Surrey Hotel has an exquisite ambience with great staff. I personal like to thank concierges Michael and Lorena who where exceptional and a pleasure to deal with. They assisted us in: getting front row seat at two plays, night river cruise, and unique daily sight seeing venture. On my wife’s birthday, Michael and Lorena sent to our room a birthday card and a chilled bottle of sparkling wine. I would highly recommend a stay at The Surrey. You will not be disappointed.

name: Crowne Plaza Suites Houston - Near Sugar Land
title: “Surprisingly comfortable stay”
text:
Shared a double bed suite with 2 other friends for another friend's wedding. Didn't expect much from this hotel from the exterior or the location. However, upon getting to my room I was pleased to see a spacious room which was relatively clean. The suite we had also had a pull out sleeper sofa so the 3 of us were very comfortable. Beds were surprisingly comfortable and I slept like a baby. Internet seemed to work for my friend with no problems and was free. Parking was not an issue either AND free.
Only complaints would be less than friendly customer service from the staff. The common areas of the hotel seem worn and the room itself was dark, partly due to the layout of the suites.
Really just an average hotel, but maybe because I had low expectations I am giving this hotel a "very good" rating. +1 for the relatively comfortable bed and good night's sleep. -1 for the mediocre customer service from the staff.

name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th
title: “This Place has sure lost a step!”
text: The beds are beat and indented, nothing more annoying than that from a property who claims to have great beds!!! The curtains were filthy and im not sure about the cleanliness of the sheets either.. eek. The employees at the front desk were pleasant yet totally unaccomadating and both conciereges we had contact with treated us with disdain just for walking in the property. Ick! rude And dumb, worst combination! I was here for sons 18th birthday and his first trip to NY, I wrote that on the reservation I made and every request I had was denied and to top it off we got the obligitory 'come back at 3pm'. The rooms were ready at 1pm I know they were. Now listen that gets a little old especially when its a Monday and the rooms were only half sold out on Sunday night !! Lame!! NO consideration at all!! There is a 'restaurant' and I walked in the restaurant door and was snapped at that I shouldnt be in there. "wha??" Then lock the damn door!! This was all on a rewards night through Hilton Honors boy was that a waste of 40,000 points dont stay here, it sucks now...

name: The Surrey
title: “My absolute home away from home - incredible experience!”
text: I had the amazing pleasure of staying at The Surrey hotel in NYC and what completely blown away by it. From my late night arrival, the staff was incredibly warm and welcoming, my accommodations were so comfortable that I never wanted to leave, the food and service in the bar - I am at a loss for words. This property is a gem - a hidden secret that won't be secret for long. Definitely go and experience this hotel - you will never want to stay anywhere else. You can tell that service is important to the staff here and it comes from the top down it appears. I had the chance to meet the General Manager who exemplifies service. I will absolutely be back and will be spreading the word!

name: YOTEL New York at Times Square West
title: “Super stylisches Trend-Hotel”
text: Das Hotel ist einfach klasse! Die Lage perfekt sowol für die Anreise vom Flughafen als auch also Ausgangsposition. Die Zimmer sind sehr hübsch und stylisch, nicht besonders groß aber insgesamt ist alles super gelöst! Das Bett ist zum ausfahren, so dass man es in eine Couch umwandeln kann und etwas mehr Platz hat. Das Personal ist sehr aufmerksam und sehr freundlich. "Auf 4", das ist der Bereich mit Rezeption, Bars und Restaurant gibt es 3 PCs mit kostenlosem Internetzugang, die Bars sind super und das Essen auch einfach nur toll. Am Wochenende gibt es Brunch mit DJ, da ist richtig was los, und es sind sicherlich nicht nur Hotelgäste, die hier unterwegs sind, sondern viele New Yorker Trend-People ;-). Wir können es nur empfehlen, einfach ein tolles Hotel!

name: The St. Regis Houston
title: “Wow!”
text: I had never stayed at a St. Regis before. When looking for a hotel in Houston, I wanted something near the Galleria. I used priceline to bid on 5 star hotels in that area and got this hotel for $120/night. I was initially a bit worried about it since the reviews implied a nice but older hotel. After having stayed there, however, I would say yes it is older, but it has been updated and well maintained. The staff is truely exceptional. What I expect from 5 star hotels in Asia rather than the US. Yes, valet parking is pricey ($27/night) and there are lots of people to tip. But they were so nice and the service so great I didn't mind. The room was great and huge. The bed was luxurious. Internet is not free. The bathroom was great. The gym was surprisingly small, but had an attendant who brought me a free headphone, towel, and cold water bottle! This is not the boutiquey/hip hotel I usually stay at. But I would say this is classic elegance. If I need a hotel in Houston again, I would not hesitate to stay here. Loved it!

name: Crowne Plaza Suites Houston - Near Sugar Land
title: “This hotel was wonderful, friendly, accomadating, and a great place to stay.”
text:
My sister and I recently visited Houston to attend the 100th birthday party of our aunt. We chose to stay at Crowne Plaza, and that was a good decisions. The staff took very good care of us, and Sarai at the front desk called us a cab, printed off our boarding passes, and, in general, helped make our stay very pleasant. Ray, in the lounge, was very nice and accomadating both evenings we were there when we went to the bar for a drink. Our trip was great--thank you Crowne Plaza!
Peggy Manning

name: The Surrey
title: “J'ai adoré !”
text:
Je connais bien d'autres hôtels a new york mais celui ci est très décoré (visiblement récemment rénové) le service y est excellent, les chambres magnifiques, les prestations et amenities en chambres vraiment géniales ! et je ne vous parle meme pas de la literie... un bonheur....
Au calme loin du broua du midtown et 2 pas de central park !
 en bref : excellentissime !

name: Hilton Garden Inn Houston Northwest
title: “Clean, Quiet, Perfect!”
text: Stayed on July13, 2012. Got the room through Priceline for $51!! What a deal. The staff were very nice, the room quiet and clean. The beds and pillows were very comfortable. Each of our beds had three pillows -- one firm, one medium, and one soft and flat (my personal favorite). Lots of nice toiletry samples in the bath. I will definitely stay here on my next trip to this part of Houston

name: Hilton Garden Inn Times Square
title: “Hilton Garden Inn - Veldig sentralt!”
text:
Rask innsjekk og rommet var stort med svær seng, flat-skjerm, tomt kjøleskap til å fylle opp med egne godsaker, sittegruppe med to stoler og bord, og gratis trådløst internett.
Det beste er at hotellet ligger 5 minutter unna Times Square og nærmeste t-bane stasjon med direktelink til JFK flyplassen (via airtrain), eller til Penn. station og flytog til Newark flyplassen.
Hotellet skryter forresten av å ha en egen bar på toppet v bygget med kjempeutsikt. Problemet er at alle bygningene rundt er minst 4 ganger så høye og at hotellbaren er "invite only".

name: Doubletree Guest Suites Times Square
title: “Pleasant stay and great breakfast buffet”
text: Right in the middle of New York's Time Square, this Double Tree by Hilton property provides all the amenities to make your stay in NYC very pleasant. Staff was friendly and accommodated all the needs of our family. Rooms a bit small to be consider "Suites" yet, comfortable enough for a family of three. The food quality and service in the Breakfast buffet was superb. Also, recently stayed in the Waldorf Astoria using same amount of Hilton Honors points and after this experience I will rather stay in this property. Parking was $35 (quite a deal for Midtown). Welcome cookies were not freshly baked as advertised, yet a nice welcome treat after arriving from a long trip.

name: The London NYC
title: “Great location, fantastic rooms, good service.”
text:
We stayed here recently for a few nights at the beginning of our holiday. The hotel is in a great location, the rooms are gorgeous and comfortable. 
The only complaint we had was that we had to ask three times for a fridge to be brought up and that there was a random $7 minibar charge on checkout even though we never even opened the door - but it was taken care of with no hassle. And these were matched by the courteous and helpful doorman who got us to Penn Station in the hotel's complimentary vehicle in the pouring rain - that was a great gesture.
So, our recommendation would be to stay here - and book the Vista Suite. It's a great hotel.

name: The London NYC
title: “When you've found this hotel, there is no reason to continue looking!”
text:
I shared a suite with my travelcompany. Excellent beds, very nice bathroom with luxurious showers. Quiet even though it is fairly central (ten min. walk to Time Square). Air Conditioning that works very quickly both colder and warmer. Excellent service. We didn't try out the hotels breakfast, since it was not included, and we found it a bit expensive. But because of the central location, we went out and found excellent cafes and breakfast bars everywhere. 
Location close to MoMA (Museum of Modern Art), Time Square and Central Park. Also easy to go downtown by bus or metro.
Worth a stay or five!!

name: Sanctuary Hotel New York
title: “Wonderful Stay”
text: Very good experience at Sanctuary, the staf very friendly and helpful,room clean and beautiful but a little bit tiny. Near Time Square, Radio City Music Hall, Rock Feller Center. Maybe the only think that should be add is a restaurant inside the hotel. For the rest everything was perfect.

name: YOTEL New York at Times Square West
title: “Yotel New York”
text:
O hotel é muito novo e bonito. Tem um clima muito jovem e está sempre recebendo eventos em seu restaurante e bar localizados no lobby. Os pontos negativos ficam por conta da falta de porta no banheiro, que só tem uma curtina e uma porta de vidro transparente para isolá-lo do resto do quarto e para o café da manhã básico, que só oferece muffins e bebidas. O resto ou o café completo devem ser pagos a parte. Mas isso pode ser nogociado na reserva.
A localização é muito boa, a apenas 5 minutos a pé da Times Square e 3 minutos do metrô.
De um modo geral o hotel é muito bom, com uma equipa muito pretativa e eu recomendaria para outros viajantes.

name: Hilton Garden Inn Houston Northwest
title: “Wonderful Experience”
text: Great staff. We held a meeting here with 32 attendees, and everything was great. Food was excellent, service was beyond expectations. Would definitely use this hotel again.

name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Houston Bush IAH South
title: “First time at La Quinta - Never again!!!! POOR SERVICE”
text: I would not come back. Lady at the desk took 20 minutes to check us in. (non one else to check in during this time) Requested non feather pillows at 6PM. Front desk person had no idea if they had any non feather pillows. Had to wait for her manager to show. When the manager showed at 6:30 I talked to her and she indicated that they had no non feather pillows.Requested she please check. After a 15 minute wait at the desk she confirmed she had some and would switch while we went for supper. When we got back from supper no pillows. When I called she refused to deliver because she was by herself. Not sure why the manager could not have looked after this as promised before she left for the day. They have an HR management problem... Can anyone help me to find an email address for corporate so I can give them feedback? Website seems deficient of any interest in getting feedback.

name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Houston Bush IAH South
title: “Nice Hotel”
text: The Hotel is Average with Nice courteous Staff.The pool was nice and clean however we didnt visited it . In less money u can enjoy complimentart breakfats and gym . In my view is a good hotel .

name: Doubletree Guest Suites Times Square
title: “Great location and suite style rooms, but little else”
text: Right on Times Square so location could not be better. Hardly any other facilities. However, restaurant served tasty food. Room was a sitting room and bedro with two doubles. We were badly advised on booking that it could accommodate 6 of us and as a result it was very cramped. We needed two suites and would have happily paid for it had they been available.

name: Hilton Garden Inn Houston Northwest
title: “Very accomodating staff”
text: The hotel overall was very nice. Shopping, restaurants, services were very accessible. I was particularly happy with the staff. Domingo, as a breakfast host was fantastic. He was gracious and very helpful and entertaining as well. He presented as a very professional yet personable member of the Hilton family. The front desk staff members were very helpful as well. Numerous needs were dealt with within minutes of a request. I would highly recommend this hotel if you are traveling in the Houston area.

name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Houston Bush IAH South
title: “La Quinta”
text:
El hotel está muy cerca del aeropuerto lo que lo hace muy cómodo si hay que tomar vuelos temprano como tuve que hacer yo.
Todos los empleados muy amables y serviciales. La habitación era grande, cómoda, todo era nuevo y estaba limpio.

name: The Houstonian
title: “Amazing service”
text: This is a nice hotel but was makes it great is the staff. They were exceptionally courteous and eager to help. The rooms were large but not well soundproofed as we could hear all the noise in the hallway. The pool area was nice but got very busy because it’s shared with patrons of the neighbouring Health club so that impacts on the tranquillity the hotel is trying to promote.

name: Embassy Suites Houston - Energy Corridor
title: “Nice hotel for great price”
text:
We decided to take a trip to Houston for Spring Break with our children and I picked this hotel due to the positive reviews, good price, free breakfast and the indoor heated pool for my kids.
It is a very pretty hotel. And our room was very large, we had a king bed and our own tv and my kids slept in the other room on the sleeper sofa and they had their own tv. I couldn't believe how nice the hotel was for the price. The pool was enjoyable, a bit small, but clean and warm. The free breakfast was like a breakfast buffet, the largest hotel breakfast I've ever seen in my life.
The only problems we had which were very minor were that when I reserved the hotel online it stated I could have extra towels in the room when we arrived and that wasn't the case. Also at the manager's reception, the bartender gave me a nonalcoholic drink in a plastic cup and gave the other adults real drinks, not sure why. She seemed kinda snotty. But the free snacks were really tasty. After room service came the first night they didn't leave any extra towels, only 3 towels for my family of 4 and no new shampoo or soaps, that would have been nice.

name: Hilton Garden Inn Times Square
title: “sehr empfehlenswertes Stadthotel auch für Familie”
text:
sehr gute Lage für Uptown, Timessquare um die Ecke, ebenso U-Bahn. Superiorzimmer empfehlenswert, da in oberen Etagen weniger Straßenlärm. Platz ausreichend auch für Reise mit 2 Kindern. Reichhaltiges Frühstück im eigenen Restarant, aber auch viele Straßencafes und 24h Foodstores in unmittelbarer Nachbarschaft. Sehr gutes Preis-Leistungsverhältnis bei Buchung als Superior mit Frühstück.
August allerdings sehr heiß und anstrengend.

name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Westchase Mini-Suites
title: “Texas turn key”
text: Stayed here for 4 days...nice sized rooms, I like the suite concept. Breakfast was good, both cold and hot choices. Staff we always very friendly and accomodating. Keep up the great work. Will be back

name: Swissotel Chicago
title: “Other Hotels In Area Equally As Good For Lower Price”
text:
With a couple major conventions going on at once, the Swissotel was one of the last options available during the dates I required. Having stayed at this hotel previously (4 years ago) I was OK with it but the price seems out higher then competitive hotels in the immediate area.
During my stay everything was good, except for the Saturday night. That evening, a large group was having a party on our floor - it was cleared out by 11pm, but then again at 2:30am it started getting REALLY LOUD. I felt like the party was in my room!
It took awhile for the staff (security?) to arrive and break things up, but then a brawl broke out - glass was being shattered, and sounded like several fights broke out and people were yelling and screaming like crazy! I assume at some point the police showed up, and then we had hours of noise (cleaning staff?) going on outside our door. In the morning, the pictures that were in the hall were gone, and the place was somewhat tidy. Having to get up at 6am for the convention I was attending, this was a horrible night's sleep. 
The rest of the stay was OK, but after having "Project X" take place outside of my hotel room door, and the cost compared to other hotels in the area (I typically stay at the Hyatt for $100 to $150 less per night), I will avoid this hotel in the future.
TIP - make sure you find the entrance to the Pedway - saves a lot of time and going outside in inclement weather if heading towards Michigan Avenue.

name: Doubletree Guest Suites Times Square
title: “Excellent, remarkably quiet hotel in the middle of Manhattan!”
text: I accompanied my husband on a business trip. He was giving a seminar at the Doubletree Guest Suites Times Square and we stayed there. The hotel is a highrise over Times Square, with a discreet entrance on Broadway at 47th St. The main lobby is on the 3rd floor. This arrangement keeps the lobby away from the bustle of the outside. We stayed on the 11th floor and there was almost no street noise at all! I'm a former New Yorker and know how difficult it is to escape the roar of the city. The rooms are small suites, very comfortably laid out, with big screen TV's and good amenities. The dual coffee maker is a particular asset. Linens are top quality and the bed is comfortable. There's a nice restaurant on the 5th floor. Service is EXCELLENT and FAST. They provide robes and slippers on request.

name: The Sutton Place Hotel
title: “The 1980s called...”
text:
...and they want their bathroom back. This place hasn't had a major renovation since it opened as the Kempinski decades ago. While the bed and linens are quite comfortable, for a hotel of this class, the bathroom needs an update and the TV needs to be a flat screen. The gigantic swivel tube TV with the worst cable TV package I've seen isn't what's expected at this supposed level.
Location and staff were great, views are also very good city views.
It's also one of those hotels that charges for wifi (why do cheap hotels give it away and more expensive ones diddle guests for $10-15 a day?). Thankfully I was able to pick up an unlocked signal from a nearby residential building and didn't pay a dime!
Stay here for price. There are plenty of equally nice hotels in this area. Don't pay more than you need to.

name: City Suites Hotel
title: “An overall dirty experience”
text: My family stayed at the City Suites and first of all walked up step that were both perilous in being tilted and soft as well as cramped. As we entered the door the smell of the room was quite bad but after a while you got over it. The rooms were pretty small as well. We then saw the snacks and refrigerator full of goodies with which the hotel hoped to pilfer the remainder of our cash through temptation. We decided to leave all of those things as they were and that so far nothing was very bad. So I sat down on the couch and smelled something funny. I did not think so much about it seeing as the whole room smelled funny but a few hours later as I was lying down on the couch I sniffed the seat and all of a sudden I knew what I had smelled. Urine. Luckily the bathroom seemed to be clean so I showered in there and asked for the cushions to be replaced. Twelve hours later the place still smelled and felt dirty. I went to sleep and throughout the night I heard, "Beep Beep, doors are closing," from the train next door.

name: Residence Inn Chicago Downtown
title: “OK but needs refreshing”
text:
Booked this hotel so as to have more room than a standard hotel. Elevators were exceptionally tiny....like 4-6 max w/o luggage....and only 2 elevators in the lobby. Room was large...but furniture was worn out. One of the two easy chairs was actually worn through to the stuffing....time to replace it. Couch was not far behind. Kitchen was nice. Bathroom was outside of the bedroom....two double closets in the bedroom. I got the impression that this place might have been apartments at one time. The bath did look recently updated and was nice. 
Breakfast in the morning was good. Real eggs, not powdered. A separate room for waffles! Lots of seating options...couches/chairs, high top tables, regular tables...so you didn't feel like you were in a cafeteria. 
Valet parking only....$47...but I guess that is the norm in Chicago.
Just wasn't wowed by this place. Needs some TLC. Decent value for Chicago if you need the extra room.

name: The Houstonian
title: “Attended a wedding”
text:
For a 5 star hotel, I was quite dissappointed overall. First, my friend was having her wedding there, and she had already paid $30.000 to the hotel for the wedding this past weekend. When we arrived, they requested a criedt card which she thought was taking care of but the front desk wouldn't let her through. Finally, we had to request the events manager to straighten it out. 
We had only an hour to get ready for the rehearsel, but it turned out to be less time because the bellman didn't get our baggage up in time. The other problem was that she had request two queen size beds, but only got one king with a sleeper. But it was too late to change since we were going to be late for the rehearsel. The bellman told us that they would make up the sleeper to be comfortable. It was horrible and I knew that I had a long day ahead so I needed some sleep. Unfortunately, I only received 4 hours of sleep that night and was exhausted the next day. 
Service overall was decently but not 5 star quality. The wedding was spectacular, but that is because had invested so muhc into it. The hotel itself was dissappointing.
The best thing is that coffee was veryvery strong and that was perfect.

name: Hilton Garden Inn Chicago Downtown/Magnificent Mile
title: “Great location for this hotel makes it a convenient place to stay!”
text:
Check in was fast, nice after 13+ hours on the road. Staff were especially friendly and courteous.
Accessible room was nice and spacious, especially the bathroom. Well done.
Room had microwave and fridge, nice for those leftovers from all the close-by restaurants.
I know some people have complained about street noise, but didn't really notice it, except for the odd siren. Being downtown, it's never going to be absolutely quiet. Overall noise was very good for 15th floor. We did however hear the ice dispenser/vending machine once in a while as they were right next door. Air conditioner was a bit loud but blocked out other sounds, worked great and was programmable. 
Pool was small but nice, with a whirlpool.
The location is the best: Right across from 'Red' line train and so close to magnificent mile and other great shops and restaurants. It was so hard to choose where to eat, especially with the Weber Grill attached to the hotel. Continental breakfast buffet for $11 including OJ and coffee was good value. $14 for Deluxe.
Really my only small issue is that the elevators seemed to be slow and quite full at peak hours.
If I'm ever back in downtown Chicago, I would definitely stay again.

name: The Houstonian
title: “Når Houston viser sig fra sin bedste side”
text:
Efter en meget lang rejsetid fra Danmark var det en fantastisk oplevelse at komme til dette hotel, som ikke havde oversolgt sig selv i billeder og tekst.
Vi skulle have været der i 3 dage, men tog en ekstra overnatning. Vi rejste med 2 voksne børn, som også var begejstret. Også pool området er helt overvældende med bruse- og badefaciliter i en grad, som vi ikke ser i DK.

name: Hilton Times Square
title: “Great place to stay!”
text: Great hotel and staff was very accomodating to our requests. We asked for adjoining rooms and got them. Rooms were large and very clean. The safe is underneath the beverage refrigerator. The hair dryers are not on the wall in the bathroom but in the closet in a canvas bag. One of our rooms had a robe and the other didn't, so you may have to ask for one. Even though we were on the 23rd floor, we felt the view was great. As others have stated, it is hard to see from the street so look for the black and white clock. Since our flight did not leave until late in the evening (8:45 p.m.) we called for luggage pickup and they took all 9 pieces to storage. All we had to do was tip them when we picked them up. Very convienent to the subway and bus tours. We did not eat in the restaurant based on other's reviews. There is an Applebee's attached to the building that serves breakfast. It was as good as Roxy's and about half the price. Someone left a review and said Dallas BBQ across the street had breakfast but they do not serve breakfast now. There is also a McDonald's (world's largest they say) right next door. Also, there is a three-story pharmacy across the street with an ATM. There is a pizza place across the street on the corner. (not PAX)..don't go there!

name: Hilton Garden Inn Chicago Downtown/Magnificent Mile
title: “Fantastic Location- Staff don't know what their talking about”
text:
This hotel was in a fantastic location (5/5). Right downtown, close to most major sites (ohio street beach, navy pier, millenium park, art institute, magnificient mile, quick bus ride to shedd aquarium & soldier field, quick bus ride to the Lincoln Park Zoo etc.). The red line is 15 steps away. Lots of restuarants and pubs/piano bars near by. Hotel was nice. Rooms were fine (a tad small for four people) but werevery clean and tidy. The Wifi was constantly cutting out. Great view from the room. Indoor pool was a little small for the amount of rooms this hotel has. Unfortunately the staff didn't know the general basics of the hotel such as "when does the pool close". One out of the four staff members I had asked was correct. Do not ask the bell man questions. 
Overall, good hotel but only because of it's location! Book with hotels.com. You get a cheaper rate.

name: City Suites Hotel
title: “Great Place for a fun trip”
text: Nice small hotel right next to the red line - you can be downtown in just a few minutes. Great staff - friendly and helpful. Fast and easy wireless internet. Very fun neighborhood even though there seems to be a lot of small businesses struggling - something for everyone - try Schuba's down the street for a great place to drink and listen to music. A lot of second-hand stores for scoring that hard-to-find book or record album or even a members-only jacket. I would recommend this for a Cub's game but I don't recommend going to a Cub's game for any reason (unless they are playing the White Sox).

name: Hilton Times Square
title: “I would stay again”
text:
I stayed here repeatedly for one-week periods from 2003-2005.
It was always a great experience. The location is fabulous - it's by all the trains, right in the heart of Times Square. There are drugstores, eateries, movie theatres and all things New York right there.
I would recommend this hotel to anybody, and I would definitely stay again. I suggest asking for a high floor so that you get a good view of the city from your room.

name: Hyatt Chicago Magnificent Mile
title: “Very impressed with the Hyatt”
text: My friends and I stayed here for a Girls' Weekend. The hotel lobby is on the second floor. We arrived at the hotel about 1:30 and were able to check in right away. The location is excellent, just 1 block off Michigan Avenue, on the lake side. We had 1 king bed and 1 rollaway. The rollaway was surprisingly comfortable and the king bed was amazing. The front desk staff was very helpful. We had no problems with anything at the hotel. They are going to be going through a multi-million dollar renovation, probably because this used to be a Wyndham and Hyatt wants to have it tailored to their style, but truthfully, I thought the furnishings were incredibly nice already, though I suppose some things were a bit dated, but not bad by any means. We did have a drink at the hotel bar and prices were about on par for other hotel bars in larger cities. I definitely would like to stay at the Hyatt again. Loved it!

name: Holiday Inn Chicago O'Hare
title: “Nice Hotel But......”
text: Second stay here and probably our last, This is a nice hotel and has superior covered parking, However on our return from 10 days in Mexico, we called for the shuttle 6 times in an hour and were finally told they couldn't locate the shuttle? We ended up taking a cab back to the hotel, in which the hotel ended up paying for the cab after a long argument with the cab driver...the manager of this hotel walked by my wife and I and never even offered an apology. Go figure?

name: Embassy Suites Hotel Chicago Downtown Lakefront
title: “Pros Outweigh Cons - Would Stay Again!”
text:
We just got back from 4 days and 3 nights in Chicago with our two kids, 4 years old and 11 months old. 
Check In - We arrived from Midway via the Orange Line (and about a mile walk) on the hottest day in 7 years. They were able to get us into a room early, about noon, which we greatly appreciated. 
Room - We were in Room 712. The room was big, but definitely in need of a little refurbishing in some areas - bathroom grout needed to be redone, a few holes in the wall from the handles hitting, stain on the front room carpet, etc. But the room itself was nice and clean and that's what's most important to us. They got us the extra towels and crib we requested without problem. Being on a low floor was nice for convenience, but would have liked a higher room for a better view.
Location - A nice location because it was close (2-3 blocks) to the bus stops that took us to all our planned locations/spots. The con was that we had to lug a stroller and two kids up multiple flights of steps to do this.
Breakfast - A nice selection. However, the line for custom made items (omelets) was NOT quick as many reviewers suggested. It was 20-25 minutes the one day I decided to do it because it was "shorter" than the other days. Not worth the wait. The chefs definitely do not dawdle and keep things moving, but not a quick wait. The buffet items are fine and warm so go with them.
Happy Hour - Again, long waits for a drink. Not worth it to us. We got snacks and non-alcoholic drinks from the dispensers 2 of the 3 nights.
Pool - A bit small, but adequate for our family. Got a little crowded at times but not too bad.
Check Out - Had to wait about 20 minutes to have the bellman watch our bags after we checked out. They need more staff on Sunday mornings for sure with checkouts.
Concierge - Got a little attitude when I asked about the easiest way to get to Willis Tower not using a cab. Apparently everyone else must do the cab route.

name: Congress Plaza Hotel
title: “worst experience!!!”
text:
I think that I will never stay here!!!
Hotel is old-fashion and the room was small and dirty. There was a dirty carpet and heat system was too hot and it was not possible change temperature...
I think this was the worst experience in my life about hotel and after 3 days I decide to change hotel paying the different for anticipating departure...
If you thing to stay in Chicago I suggest to choose a different Hotel

name: Holiday Inn Chicago O'Hare
title: “Noisy room”
text:
