If staying there, be sure to reserve some time for a walk on the boardwalk, playing on the playground (if you have kids), dinner at Ciro's right across the lake (delicious Italian food), and live entertainment at the wine shop across the lake.

name: Staybridge Suites Charlotte Ballantyne
title: “Very nice and comfortable”
text: I stayed here with my wife during the weekend of Thanksgiving '06. Everything was perfect. The service, the room, the surrounding area. The breakfast service was also very nice. The staff was courteous and helpful and tried to assist you with everything.

name: JW Marriott Indianapolis
title: “great weekend”
text: We stayed at the Indianapolis JW Marriott for a weekend on our anniversary. With the property being so new I did not know what to expect. The employees were the most helpful and friendly that I have ever run across. I travel for a living and stay at at least 50 hotels per year and was surprised at what I experienced at this property. The Italian restaurant was great and had pricing comperable to local restaurants instead of being overpriced like most hotel restaurants. I look forward to my next stay at this hotel.

name: Renaissance Charlotte Suites
title: “Great Staff”
text:
An amazing hotel indeed. We stayed for almost a week last month and I never wanted to leave :-( The gym was a lifesaver though and the staff is exceptionally trained. The food was good, however one thing that stood out for me during my stay was the 'Gift Shop' situated within the hotel. This shop had anything and everything you could and cant think of! If there is something you need that they dont carry, they immediately 'special order' it for the guest.........as they did for me. I even bought some ethnic looking apparel which I absolutely LOVE!!
The manager of the hotel should definately pat him/herself on the back for running such a great hotel.

name: TownePlace Suites Fort Worth Downtown
title: “Brand New. Very nice. Come here if you have a car.”
text:
Brand new hotel (<4 months). Very clean, comfortable, generously spacious floorplan in room. I love the kitchentte and good size closet. Breakfast was not bad (hot and cold selection and lots of bananas). Great gym with brand new / latest equipment (treadmill, stepper, a weight bench with dumbbells) - in fact one of my favorite hotel gyms.
 Awesome staff (I dealt with the night shift guys). Friendly and helpful. I left something in the closet and called the day after. Gabriel promptly sent me my belongings (charging my cc of course). 
Highly recommend if you have to be downtown and have a car. Hotel has free parking and the drive to DT is <10 min. Plenty of surface lots ($5 to $10 per day and free at night) around downtown so you don't need to worry about parking during daytime. Some even take credit cards. The lots on the north side near Sundance are closer to $10. If you're going to the Convention Ctr area, park near Monroe/Taylor street and you'd find lots @ $5/day. Also on weekend, meter parking is free. This place is not too convenient if you don't have a car though. 
When driving to the hotel on Weatherford, resist the urge to turn left when approaching Belknap. When you see the sign 'Pecan St', stay right and NOT get on the ramp. The road then turns left under the overpass. That road will be Belknap and the hotel emerges as soon as you get thru the overpass.

name: HYATT house Charlotte Center City
title: “Probably the best hotel I've ever stayed at”
text: This place was fantastic. We got a really low rate on Hotwire, and we were pleasantly surprised by the accommodations -- a full kitchen, a living area, an amazing bed, a flat-screen TV. A really luxurious place that also has free breakfast! Who's ever heard of that before. Friendly staff, too, and a great location. Highly recommended.

name: Argonaut Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel
title: “Great location, lovely hotel”
text:
Fantastic location for tourist attractions.
Room clean and (relatively) restrained in theming. Lobby relaxed setting.
Internet access useful. Wine tasting a bonus.
Staff service efficient and courteous.

name: Sheraton Suites Columbus
title: “If booking rate that includes breakfast, read this -”
text:
I booked two rooms for 6 people each for this past weekend (suites that could accomodate 6 people each, with two double beds and a sofabed). I was specifically looking for a hotel that included breakfast, and I found that the AAA rate on the Sheraton website says "Breakfast Included." When we arrived to check in, I inquired about this, as I know their breakfast is in a restaurant setting, not like a Hampton or a Holiday Inn Express where you just walk in and get what you want. The woman told me that you only get vouchers for two people per room. I raised a fuss - the reservation line never gave me this information, and they let me book the room for 6 people. The confirmation email says "Breakfast Included," and it does not specify that it is only for two. She did accommodate me and give us enough vouchers for the group, but just wanted to make people aware of this if they are expecting breakfast for the entire party. 
NOW - once we got past the breakfast fiasco, we were thoroughly satisfied with this hotel. The suites are very nice, with french doors separating the bedroom from the living room. The pool and hot tub area were both very nice. And yes, breakfast was great. The hotel is convenient to Polaris, but it is away from all the hustle and bustle, which is what we were looking for after spending all day fighting the traffic and shopping. 
I would stay here again, and now I know what to expect when I book this rate.

name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites Columbus University Area - OSU
title: “Great place to stay for a Columbus visit”
text: Stayed overnight while in town for a volleyball tournament. The suite was large, clean and comfortable. The pool & hot tub area looked small but nice. There were tons of kids in it and in the hotel in general. Free breakfast buffet, not the tastiest, but free. Great price too, would stay here again.

name: Sheraton Suites Columbus
title: “Rooms comfy. Good place to stay, not to eat”
text:
Location is good as lots of nearby restaurant options. Beds and bedding excellent as usual for Sheraton. In Room coffee - (one of my pet peeves) - A+ for having Starbucks and 2 packets! In room amenities also very good. Furniture dated. Only negative was the restaurant for breakfast. Buffet was sparse, not maintained (one last cold biscuit, stone cold processed eggs, etc) and poor service. (No flatware on table and I waited a long time to get it) waiter did not come back to check anything until bringing the bill, then was loud in mentioning "the gratuity is not included " I think it is tacky to have staff ask for a tip (which I always provide anyway) but especially irratating when poor service.
I would recommend the hotel, but eat elsewhere.

name: Hawthorn Suites by Wyndham Airport Columbus East
title: “columbus hawthorn”
text: I guess I'm just spoiled-usually stay at a Marriott but thought I would try something different. First thing it was extremely difficult at night to find how to get to the motel even though you could see it from the road. Second, to walk into a room and its ice cold is not too pleasant, thrid, a lamp where the cord has the plug cut off of it-hard to plug in too get extra light since the lightening was very dull. Positive side the breakfast was excellent!

name: Hampton Inn Columbus Hamilton
title: “Bad Area & Dated Hotel”
text: We were out in Ohio for a family doing, and we were supposed to stay out here for two nights, but due to this hotel I opted to make it one night and drive home throughout the night to Chicago. The air conditioner worked poorly, was loud, the beds were hard, very few towels, noticed that the other double bed's sheets were dirty, and the area is ghetto in my opinion. I wouldn't stay here again.

name: Comfort Inn
title: “Very friendly service.”
text: Cannot say enough about the friendly service at this hotel. The room was clean and the bed was very comfortable. The indoor salt water pool and hot tub are located in a seperate building right behind the hotel. It is a very nice and well kept pool building. My girls swam there three times during our visit. The breakfast hostess Gloria was by far the best I've ever seen. She made waffles for everyone who wanted one and kept all of the drink and food containers full. She was very friendly as were the two women that worked the front desk. We will definitely return!

name: Comfort Inn
title: “These people are thieves!”
text: I left my diamond earrings on the sink and when I went back to get them the manager/owner told me that I was mistaken. She insisted that her housekeeping staff was completely honest and responsible. She made absolutely no effort to make my situation better or compensate me in any way. I filed a police report as well. If you stay here keep a good eye on your valuables!

name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Ft. Worth - Forest Hill, TX
title: “A Very Good Stay”
text: I was very impressed with the hotel. It was cleaned and the room with the king size bed was very comfortable. I travel a lot to the Fort Worth area and it was my first stay at the hotel. Even though the hotel is not located in Fort Worth, I will travel to Forest Hill to stay again because it will be the place for me to stay when I return to Fort Worth area again. When I was leaving my room to check out, a person was walking towards me (about 25 feet) and said good morning how are you. It was a staff and that was impressive because the staff did not have to say anything, but the staff did. If you are in the Fort Worth area, that is the hotel to stay.

name: Americas Best Value Inn-Columbus/West
title: “Comfy place with friendly people!”
text: I stayed here for 3 nights and the service was excellent. The staff members are very friendly and helpful. Rooms are nice, clean, and comfortable. It's located at a very quite corner of a very resourceful area. There are tons of restaurants near by and plenty of stores. There is also a movie theater within walking distance if you get bored. Whenever I go back to Columbus I would definitely choose to stay at the America's BEST VALUE Inn!

name: Motel 6 Columbus Worthington
title: “AVOID AVOID AVOID”
text: Decided to give it a try due to renovations. Paid for my room and then went to check out the bed. Room had very strong medicinal smell upon entrance. Pulled back the mattress cover to check for bed bugs. Saw small brown specks - I don't think they were bed bugs but they were something. Pulled mattress away from platform and saw lots of dust and hair, and also a porno mag. Could not stay here and got full refund. Go across the street to the Days Inn and pay $5 more per night; well worth it. Obviously the standards of the Motel 6 management are not the same as most American travelers.

name: North Suites
title: “Disgusting”
text: Needed a reasonably priced pet friendly room near the hotel where my husband was attending a conference. Arrived late which was good for the hotel as we were not able to see the grounds/landscaping. Had our first concerns at the front door and lobby where everything was smudgy and dusty. Quick check in. After that everything was completely nasty. I really can't list everything; reference all the other reviews and I would include all in mine here. Wish I had taken pictures. Beer bottles in front drive remained the 3 days of our stay despite notifying front desk person. This was once be a nice property but there is obviously no interest in any type of upkeep. Choice properties should seriously consider removing this hotel from their family of properties. We did enjoy our meal in the Thai restaurant on site.

name: Embassy Suites Fort Worth Downtown
title: “Week in Fort Worth”
text:
I have had been staying in Fort Worth with business this entire week at this hotel. The hotel is located in the middle of downtown Fort Worth with several great little restaurants and pubs within walking distance. The rooms are great. Very clean, nice television sets etc. Everything that I would expect from an Embassy Suites.
What has compelled me to write this review is not the property itself, as I expect this level of excellence when staying at an Embassy Suites, but rather the staff. Two of us arrived on Motorcycles on Monday after fighting rain all of the way from Oklahoma. By the time we arrived neither of us were in any mood to try and find where to park Motorcycles, haul luggage, wait while someone looked up our reservations etc. We were pleasantly suprised when we Yusf met us at the door, explained how parking worked with motorcycles, took our gear and then walked us to the parking area. Great service, we talked basketball on the way back. Super young man. 
Breakfast has been fantastic all week and happy hour is a great time. Tammy, and another great member of the staff, braved the intimidating group of loud old men that I was with last evening at happy hour to set with us, ask about our stay, and listen to our stories and jokes. 
This truly a great place to stay. The entire staff has treated us with the same hospitality as Tammy and Yusf. I will stay here every time I am in Fort Worth (if they let me)

name: Ramada Inn East Airport
title: “Excellent Hotel For the Price!!”
text: I have to say, when I pulled up, I was unsure because the price was so inexpensive...but when I opened the door to this room I was more than presently surprised. The room was huge, and really nice. The staff was courteous and very helpful! Ill definitely stay again!

name: Residence Inn Columbus Worthington
title: “I Must Not Be a Light Sleeper”
text:
I was very happy at this property and I had a room on the train side of the hotel. The noise didn't bother me, but I'd request a room in the front if you are a light sleeper.
I thought the hotel was in very good condition and very clean - both the common areas and my room. The room is bigger than many of the Residence Inns where I have stayed with a full size refrigerator, microwave and all the kitchen stuff you'd expect. A nice size LCD TV (42"?) which swivels for viewing anywhere in the room.
The internet works great - wired and wireless.
A nice feature is that they kept the breakfast open well past 9:00 on weekdays - a nice change from most places where they start packing up the breakfast within seconds of the end time. A great selection of foods at breakfast and a very friendly woman running the show.
They allow pets, which would normally make me avoid the place, but the room had absolutely no trace of any animal ever having been there.
There is only one computer in the common area with no chair, so you'll really want to bring your own. On the other hand, it keeps people from camping out so If you have something quick to do - this is for you.

name: Wingate by Wyndham Columbus
title: “Comfortable and quiet - we are staying there again”
text: We were staying only one night to attend a meeting and arrived the evening before the meeting. The front desk staff was friendly and gave very good directions to the resturant where we wanted to have dinner. We had a non-smoking double bed room with PLENTY of towels and we took two of those to the pool. We checked out the fitness center and were sorry to see the spa was closed. Breakfast was fine and the area was clean. Staff was on top of keeping milk containers filled, food replenished, etc. The hotel is located in a high traffic area but we were quite surprised that we didn't hear ANY noise at all. It was a GREAT VALUE and we have already made reservations to return for the next scheduled meeting. Very confortable beds - not hard as rocks - with plenty of nice pillows. Although it is an older hotel, it is not rundown and has ice machines on EVERY floor.

name: Embassy Suites Fort Worth Downtown
title: “THE NATION’S FINEST”
text:
I have stayed in many hotels in my life but this is the absolute best in the country. You are greeted kindly first by the valets as they unpack your car, then before you get into the for yore the reception staff is standing there to greet you and mostly by name instantly making you feel like a celebrity. After you experience the express check in and move on to your room, the well designed suite invites you in almost as much as the hand written note and treats on the countertop.
The rooms are comfortable but the morning’s breakfast staff and “manager’s receptions” are incredible. Every single staff member will absolutely exhaust their resources finding you answers to any of your questions from hotel amenities, to local events and even so much as sporting event tickets. I am pleased writing this review knowing I’ll be back in a few weeks as should you.

name: Days Inn Columbus North
title: “Days Inn Columbus North”
text: I regularly stay at Days Inn Motels. Most are satisfactory. The Days Inn Columbus North was more than satisfactory. The room was clean, the bed was nicely made, the breakfast offered a number of items. The only thing I can find fault with is the TV reception on certain channels.

name: Days Inn Columbus Fairgrounds
title: “All about the location”
text: If it wasn't for the location i would not have stayed here and next year i think i will stay farther way to have a better place. The breakfast was horrible. its very cheap!

name: Comfort Suites - Columbus / Keim Circle
title: “Wonderful Stay”
text: This was our first time at this particular motel. 2 Friendlay Gals greeted me at the desk.I had made reservations in advance so check in was fast. 2 Queen beds,a nice sofa ,good sized fridge & microwave. Did take a while for the A/C to cool the room down,but later it was real cool. Breakfast was waffles,eggs,bacon & sausage,and the usuall cereal donuts,etc. Nice & quiet stay. When ready to take luggage to car the woman that was cleaning the windows even offered to help me get things to the car. Would stay there again. I used some Choice points for a free stay!

name: DoubleTree Suites by Hilton Hotel Columbus Downtown
title: “Could be nicer...”
text: Checked in with no Issues. Room was clean & ready when we checked in. Some of our other party had to wait a couple of hours past the actual checkin time for an available room. Very slow elevators and the hotel just has an overall tired look. It could definitely use some updates. Breakfast buffet was mediocre at best. Rooms were large & mostly comfortable but the air conditioner didn't stay sufficiently cool. Staff was mostly nice & accommodating. Probably wouldn't stay again. A little disappointing overall when there are so many other options.

name: DoubleTree Suites by Hilton Hotel Columbus Downtown
title: “Nice Room-Average Everything Else”
text: Stayed June 15th-17 2012. Front desk guy Daniel very friendly and helpful- we were allowed to check in at 1:00 on a Friday- asked for a room on a higher floor which after visiting other friends in the hotel found out the 10th floor rooms were twice as big. Room was very nice, but the hotel itself does not offer much in the way amenities. No pool, restaurant was very below average. No lobby to speak of.. Two elevators are required to go from the ground floor to the rooms. The Doubletree is in a really great location- close to everything downtown. I'd consider staying here again for the same price if the property offered a pool and had a decent bar.

name: Fairfield Inn & Suites Columbus OSU
title: “Our "go-to" hotel”
text: This hotel is reliable. We stay there because it is located near my mother and visiting her is why we come to Columbus. It is not an exciting hotel but I have never had a negative experience there. Other hotels along that strip have all disappointed us in various ways so we always seem to go back to this one.

name: Comfort Suites Airport
title: “Nice little treasure on airport property”
text:
I booked this hotel before reading some of the other reviews on it. After reading them I was concerned as to what I was getting into. I was extremely pleasantly surprised by this property.
I arrived at the airport on a late evening flight and was whisked to the property by their shuttle. The young lady at the front desk promptly got me settled into my room.
The rooms are in the process of a major upgrade with bedding and carpeting. About 1/2 of the property appears done with a large block of rooms out of service as they are being done.
The morning breakfast and checkout were pleasant and efficient. I struck up a conversation with the GM and she said that the owners have made a commitment to keep improving the property.
If my future travel plans include an overnight in Columbus, this hotel will be on my list to try. Rates are average to low for an airport property.
I noticed only minimal noise from the airport in the morning.

name: Baymont Inn Columbus North
title: “the lady messed up my reservation and then my credit card got over charged breakfast was good wish there Was more fruit”
text: My room was ok and cleaned the king bed was not as comfortable as i likedthey messed up my reservation and i was not able to get the discount i was promised then my money was still not returned after i was over charged for the room.

name: Candlewood Suites Polaris
title: “So-so experience”
text: The hotel is in a very convenient location near many restaurants and shopping. It was great being able to travel with our dogs. One problem was that the Leathernecks were having a convention, and their motorcycles were very loud. The people we met from the group were very nice, but I think I would have liked a warning from the hotel about the convention when I reserved. Also, the pool heater wasn't working. Lastly, I had to reserve a smoker room because there were no non-smoking available. I had forgotten how smoke gets so embedded in things. We bought air freshener and lit candles, but nothing helped. The room was smaller than I expected. It has a nice kitchen, but only one seat at the table, which didn't work well for the three of us.

name: Baymont Inn Columbus North
title: “Microwave/fridge”
text:
My overall stay was very pleasant. However I dont understand why no fridge or microwave was available. I requested a fridge and was told they were all in use and they'd check for one. Never heard back from anyone. 3 days later I inquired again about a fridge same thing.
Guest with extended stay should have access to one or the other, maybe even both. I was there for 7 days.

name: Candlewood Suites Polaris
title: “Basic Room, nice amenities for an extended stay hotel”
text:
This is an extended stay property. That said, it's a nice one. The property seems very new and is close to a lot of restaurants and the Polaris Fashion Place. Columbus is a "driving town", though, so you would be taking your life in your hands if you wanted to cross the street. The workout room is very nice, and there is free laundry. I didn't use the pool, but it looked clean. 
The room is basic, but very clean and new. There was a DVD player with the TV, which was nice. The kitchen has all the amenities expected in a full kitchen. Housekeeping only cleans rooms once/week, and your room won't get cleaned unless you are there for at least one week. I didn't mind making my own bed. 
There is wireless internet (somewhat weak in my room) and internet access available via network cable (very fast). I had a little trouble with the climate control in my room (the first night it was 86 degrees in my room, and the next it was 62), and the fan was very noisy. The ceilings are thin and there is a fair amount of noise from people in the hallway. I recommend asking for a room on the 4th floor (top floor) so any nightime pacing from guests above your head won't bother you. 
Parking is free and plentiful. I would stay there again (and probably will in Summer 2008) as it is a good value, and I liked the full kitchen, workout room and location.

name: Baymont Inn Columbus North
title: “Shopworn, tired and desperately in need of a refresh”
text:
After reading the reviews on Trip Advisor we were a little apprehensive about staying at the hotel. While the security issues cited by one reviewer did not surface during our stay, it was a comedy of errors from check in on. When checking in we were given cards for a room on the third floor. We rode up on the elevator with a woman who had an ice bucket and learned from her that the ice machine on the first floor was the most reliable. Then we got off the elevator and headed to one room. She said "I think that's my room." It was her room but the clerk had wiped out her key access and given us new access keys for the rooms.
Once corrected we ended up on a different floor in a room that was clean but where the previous occupants had left their laundry. The room itself was shop worn with frayed carpet, a semi-dysfunctional shower curtain, a mottled and stained bathroom ceiling, small and very thin towels and thin but clean sheets. Also, the safe in the room didn't work -- kind of a security concern.
Fortunately our room was quiet but we heard from others on a different floor that their sleep had been disturbed routinely during the night.
We also attended a hospitality gathering for the group we were traveling with. Again the room was shop worn and the couch in the room was covered with a sheet. Carpet in hallways was alternately stained and bleached out.
Desk service varied widely from friendly and helpful to sullen. 
Bright spots: lots of coffee in the room and an adequate breakfast.

name: Hampton Inn Columbus Airport
title: “Showing it's age”
text: Stayed one night for business at the Hampton Inn at the airport. Although clean, it's showing it's age. Worn carpet, dimly lit hallways, worn bedding and upholstery in the rooms. Given it's right next door to a brand new Hilton Garden Inn - I'll make sure I book there next time.

name: Fairfield Inn & Suites Columbus OSU
title: “Stark contrast from the past”
text:
I was reluctant to stay here when my company booked the reservation. Though I came to find that the hotel was brand new, and no longer reminded me of a roadside motel. There's a hallway, basic services and free high speed internet (cat5).
The room decor is kinda plain, and the bed blanket looks old and ratty (multiple rooms and multiple stays). They could use new bedding.
The cable system has plenty of options and the bathroom is spacious and generally clean (I have encountered loose hairs here and there).
Overall it's a decent stay. The location is great for The Ohio State University, and the staff is generally pleasant.
There's a Damon's restaurant literally in the parking lot that my co-workers love.

name: Renaissance Worthington Hotel Fort Worth
title: “Worst Experience Ever - reserved/paid for a King got singles/twin”
text: 2nd visit - guaranteed king - would not honor our reservation - ignored requests to fix our room, lied to us about room availability as they gave four of our party of six kings AFTER we checked in although they were told no kings as well....WILL NEVER STAY THERE AGAIN....loud, out of control kids banging/slamming on doors and screaming - no free internet.

name: Days Inn Columbus Fairgrounds
title: “Drug deals, nasty room, no service, they just want your cash!”
text:
This is the worst place I have ever been. I watched 4 drug deals outside the room. I spoke to the manager about the above room bathroom leaking into ours and could not use the shower with the nasty water leaking down. Found a box of pain meds under the bed (used for makeing other drugs). I was forced to stay up all night due to strangers triing to open our door. The room was VERY dirty and stunk like weed. PLEASE, we need to shut this place down! As I checked out, I reminded the manager about these issues again. He stated...
sorry. Please, DO NOT SUBJECT YOUR FAMILY TO THIS.

name: Chancellor Hotel on Union Square
title: “Okay but could have been better”
text:
We stayed at the Chancellor in late December including New Years Eve where we anticipated that things would be happening at the Square.
However, due to the riots of New Years Eve 2005, the Union Square grassed area was fenced off this year ensuring that everyone would attend the riots down on the foreshore in 2006!
The Chancellor is one of those hotels where everything seems okay and pleasant enough but things just do not seem to come together.
The room was okay but nothing special. The entrance was functional and check in smooth but nothing special.
The biggest plus was that the Cable Car stop was very close and the major shops were reasonably close. There is also a 24 hour pharmacy four doors up. But once again, nothing ignited me about the place.
The thing that saddened me most about SFO was the amount of poverty and maybe this jaded me against the Chancellor.
I think next time I am in SFO is to head down to the Wharf area. It seemed reasonable alive even at 11am in the morning.

name: Days Inn & Suites Worthington
title: “no where near good.”
text:
we needed a hotel last minute on a busy marathon weekend in columbus OH.
We paid $100 for an upgraded suite so our daughter could have a sofa bed.
Inside the mattress was a pen and under the sofa it was unclean with a plastic cutlery item
and coin and lots of dust. There was no linen for the sofa bed, and so when we phoned to reception we were told to "come down and pick it up" This was surprising as we had specifically
booked the room with the sofa bed.
The stair case up to our room on the 2nd floor (Note there are no elevators) were dirty and
needed a good vacuum. Cant comment on the breakfast as we had to leave very early in the morning. It is in an easy location with the Polaris shopping mall only minutes away.

name: Courtyard by Marriott Columbus Worthington
title: “Middle of the Road Choice - Many Better Options in Columbus”
text: Agree with most of the general comments already posted. Staff was professional, room adequate, property conveniently located. Kind of a mixed bag. Property could use some updates. Pool is tiny. Lot's of dinning options nearby - within walking but agree with other reviewer on having to park in a secluded area in the back. While nothing happened during our stay I kind of watched my back coming in after dark. The most striking thing about this property is that, well, nothing is strikingly bad or strikingly good. Just kind of ho-hum experience. If you're working within a 5 minute drive don't hesitate to book but if you're looking for someplace memorable - keep looking. There are many great possibilities in Columbus.

name: Sheraton Suites Columbus
title: “A Perfect Stay”
text:
My daughter and I along with our "labradoodle dog" stayed 1 night at this hotel. We had a 
beautiful suite room with 2 flat panel TV's on the 8th floor for Starwood Preferred Guests. 
The room also had a microwave and fridge. The bathroom was very nice and our stay was lovely. The only thing this hotel should invest in is a good chef. The room came with a buffet breakfast and it wasn't good. Good hotel food is essential.

name: Red Roof Inn Columbus West
title: “Great stay...”
text:
We stay at this Red Roof Inn every year when we visit Columbus, OH. We have always had a pleasant visit at this motel and find the staff to be very good.
The location is convenient to everything we want to do when visiting Columbus and there are many places to eat very close to this motel. The price is very competitive to other motels in the area.
The room had been updated but the box springs needs to be replaced.

name: Renaissance Columbus Downtown Hotel
title: “Renaissance Columbus”
text: It was a nice hotel. Staff was great! We had a king room that was small. Housecleaning needs to check the drawers. We found questionable items in the night stand. Yuck! The food was good, We never had to wait for an elevator even though they were very busy.

name: Fort Rapids Indoor Waterpark Resort
title: “OMG--- Save Your Money!!!!!!”
text:
We recently did a birthday party at Ft Rapids indoor WaterPark on a Saturday. It was an absolute ZOO! The locker room and inside the park was dirty and disgusting. There were wall to wall people and not enough rafts available. Teens swearing and flipping the bird to our crew of 11 year olds. The staff was doing their best and Danielle, who looked after us in the party room, was wonderful. Pizza was terrible but the cake was good.
All in all I will have nightmares about this place for years to come and will not be going back.

name: Doubletree Hotel Columbus Worthington
title: “Great Stay”
text: We had a great experience all around. Much better than Country Inn by far.

name: DoubleTree Suites by Hilton Hotel Columbus Downtown
title: “Theater Reviewer's Doubletree Review ”
text:
Four of us booked a 2 room "river view" suite for a Saturday Evening. I believe with AArp and AAA it came to about $129.
Arrival:We parked at Double tree's car garage near the elevator entrance. You take an elevator to the main lobby to check in, then a separate elevator to your room. No problem, no wait at check in. 
Room: 
We were in room 410. Spacious 2 room suite.... view of the river was nice, (living room) desk for you business people, fridge, sink, microwave, Wolf Gang Puck coffee assortment (fancy), couch, TV, over sized chair,small table with 4 chairs. 
 Bed room standard double beds,TV, dresser, a mirror "wall" outside the bathroom with shelf (perfect for 4 women) big bath room (with Nutrageena samplers). No probs with water temps of pressure, plenty to go around. 
Cleanliness wise I was say i was surprised to find red "stuff" on our curtains (blood?? pizza sauce??) who knows... and there was a golf ball sized hole in the wall, just behind the curtains with tissue shoved in it. Odd. Upon bed inspection, we found no hairs, bugs or undesirables... and slept comfortably.
Tips:
If you go to the lobby they have comp beverages (coffee, tea, ice water) and if you ask at the desk, they will give you some yummy cookies.
Ohio Theater in under a 10 min walk
Dining: Beware weekend visitors... this hotel is set in the business dist and it was tricky to find places outside of the hotel to eat (with in walking distance.)THAT WERE OPEN! There is a Subway we found about a block away (E) next to a CVS if you should need one. For dinner we hiked about 5-6 blocks (N) to "The Elevator" for a fancy dinner. And for breakfast do yourself a favor and make reservations for "First Watch" on S High (bfast was busy, but GOOD!) It's like a 2 minute drive, 15 min walk.

name: Holiday Inn Columbus-Hilliard
title: “Outstanding”
text: We were driving across I-70 and needed a place to stay the night. On a whim, we stopped at this HI and we're very glad that we did. The place is very new and modernly styled. The rooms are large, quiet and very comfortable. Large flat panel TV with 99 channels. Room was attractively furnished and well-lit. The high-speed Internet worked perfectly. The restaurant/bar was bright, cheerful and attractive. We ate breakfast there and found the food (a la carte) to be very good. The reception staff and restaurant waitress were very friendly and efficient. We were totally pleased with the hotel and found it to be excellent value for money. If we ever find ourselves in the area again, we will certainly stay there again.

name: DoubleTree Suites by Hilton Hotel Columbus Downtown
title: “Great”
text:
Customer service was outstanding. From check-in to the bar to the restaurant, everyone was extremely helpful and nice.
The only cons:
It took about ten minutes to get a warm shower
Noise from the hall was loud in the sitting/living area

name: Holiday Inn Dallas DFW Airport - South
title: “Excellent new Hotel”
text:
I stayed here for just one night layover because of a transit in Dallas between my flights from Denver to Washington DC.
This hotel is one of the best Holiday Inns that I have stayed in! It is brand new. The rooms are very large and have all the up to date amenities and mod-cons. 
The hotel also provides a free shuttle service to and from DFW airport. Unfortunately, when we arrived at DFW airport late in the evening, we did not know where was the correct place to look for the shuttle. There was a "courtesy phone" at the airport arrivals area. When we dialled the number for "Holiday Inn" on the courtesy phone to ask about the shuttle, we were given a list of 7 Holiday Inns to choose from, but NOT this particular Holiday Inn. So, we could not find the information we were looking for, and finally we took a cab, which was quite pricey.. $30 including tips. This is a hefty extra price to pay, considering that the hotel room was only $98 for 2 persons per night.
Check in was speedy and efficient. There were some restaurants within walking distance from the hotel.
We took the shuttle back to DFW early next morning.
We will definitely stay here again if we next come through Dallas/Fort Worth... but we WILL make sure we know where to board the shuttle!!!!

name: Hampton Inn & Suites Columbus-Easton
title: “I regret coming here”
text: I am sitting here at midnight writing this truly regretting ever coming here. The hotel is clean etc, but check in was slow and arduous, there are children running up and down the halls, slamming doors and screaming. It's going to be a long night. It's way overpriced and not really next to Easton. I was told by a staff member it was within walking distance but not across these busy roads!

name: Holiday Inn Dallas DFW Airport - South
title: “It only takes one bad apple...”
text: My wife and I stayed here while in town for a Rangers game due to its impressive rating on Tripadvisor (and we are Priority members). I do have to say we enjoyed the stay overall. Nice hotel in a nice area. It would have been nice to come back to the hotel lounge after the game and relax and have a drink but Saturday nights are hip-hop nights. We were aware of this and understand the hotel wanting to increase revenue so it was no problem. The problem lies with one of the bartenders (who unfortunately I did not get the name of-younger guy/short hair). I suppose since we were obvious "out to towners" or weren't Saturday night regulars then he need not worry about treating us like he cared if we were there or not. I am not going to say he ruined our trip, because we weren't going to let that happen, but he did put a damper on it. We will be coming back to the area in a couple of weeks for another game but will probably look for another hotel to stay at. There are lots of other choices and lots of other bartenders happy you are there and without the cocky attitude.

name: Comfort Inn North
title: “Nice place to stay”
text: Spent a night here with 4 other guys after a Buckeye game. The place was clean nice and friendly and in a nice location. Also had a better than average breakfast. Rooms were about average but very good for the price we paid.

name: The Westin Columbus
title: “Poor customer service- very "average" experience!”
text: Our experience was made unpleasant by screaming, fighting guests on our floor at 4am, as well as doors slamming, loud knocking/yelling and a dog barking all night-- NOT what I would expect from a Westin experience! We asked to have our room moved, and in our dealings with several employees and managers to get a room change, only ONE person offered an apology!! I don't think an "I'm sorry for your inconvenience." is too much to ask for when you work in a service industry! The room they moved us to was an upgrade in size, however, the lamp shades and bed skirting had stains. Knowing what we know now, we would NOT stay at the Westin. Guest behavior is beyond the hotel's control, however for our inconvenience to move rooms, a night of ruined sleep, for paying what we paid, worst case scenario they could have APOLOGIZED, first, and covered our parking, some drinks at the bar, etc. Any effort to make it right would have been appreciated! Disappointed, and will have to think twice about any other Westin stays in the future.

name: Holiday Inn Dallas DFW Airport - South
title: “Great Property and Service, exceeds Holiday Inn expectations”
text: Very smooth checkin as a priority club member, offered up airport shuttle service immediately. Very clean property, perhaps the cleanest holiday inn I have seen.

name: Crowne Plaza Columbus North
title: “Modern & good location”
text: Newly renovated, very modern, clean rooms! Walking distance to the arena district. Max & Erma's is next door.

name: The Westin Columbus
title: “Nice downtown property”
text:
I stayed here one night - short notice reservation thru Hotwire. If you are coming to Columbus I think this is the only 4-star property in Arena/German Village area so you are guaranteed to get Westin by choosing that option.
 Parking is in a lot adjacent to the hotel - self-park and valet are both $20 a night. Check-in was easy and pleasant - the person said she'd give me a room at the end of the hall, but I ended up in the middle of the hall. Still it was pretty quiet through-out the night.
I think this is a historic bdlg - the ceilings are high but the living area and bathroom are quite small. I like the feel but it could be a consideration if you're not alone. Outlets in the room and bathroom are not immediately apparent but they're in fairly convenient locations which is nice for older bldg. I had a room with one bed, either double or queen (not sure). White tea products are very nice and there was a wonderful jacquard Westin robe in the closet - there was only one so I hope if I had a guest there would be two?
For the shower you have to completely pull the stopper out of the tub - slightly atypical. Very nice towels. Heat and everything was good - I was impressed at modern HVAC system especially with age of bldg. Common areas are rather bland in decor like all Westin locations I've been, but very clean and quiet. 
I had a very nice breakfast - very generous with the portion of bacon and glass of juice. Breakfast delivery was pretty timely - maybe 10 min after period I requested.
Wake up call was in person (maybe 5-10 min after time I asked for) and they offered to tell me the daily weather.
Unfortunately on my bill they charged me twice for parking - I know the bills are generated automatically but it would be nice if the hotel staff could quickly review for accuracy before sliding under your door in the morning. This happens at so many places I stay and it's just one more nuisance in the morning.
TV was basic channels and HBO. I stayed in January and the HBO schedule in the room was from November. There are snacks and water for sale in the room and they also offer you key to minibar. My suggestion to hotels to make more money - give the guest option to refuse minibar key, but set it up so default setting is providing it. Guests feel like a delinquent to say "YES I would like the minibar key" if it's phrased as yes or no question. It would be better just slide it over and let you give it back if you want to.

name: Chancellor Hotel on Union Square
title: “What a great find!”
text:
Won't repeat everything that other reviewers have said except to say that if you're going to San Francisco stay at the Chancellor! It's in a great location - right at Union Square. Great value for money and spotlessly clean.
Enjoy!

name: JW Marriott Indianapolis
title: “Beautiful hotel”
text: My mom and I stayed here for the weekend when we came to Indy to see the DCI World Championships. What a beautiful hotel! I expected as much being a part of the JW series. I loved the underground parking and also how the parking garage was color coded to let you know where you needed to go. Check-in was super easy & the young woman at the front desk walked us to the elevator and explained all the hotel restaurants & other details we might want to know. Our room was perfect! It was clean, well-stocked, & had everything we possibly could want in a hotel room. We did however hit a snafu with ordering room service. It took us about an hour & a half at about 1:00 a.m. to get our room service order, but the hotel was great in making it up to us by deducting our room service bill by 50% since the food was delivered warm & was actually very tasty. This by no means hurt my rating on this hotel! We had breakfast in Osterio Pronto, and it was pretty good. The hotel overall was very nice, clean, the staff was very accomodating, and the decor was just gorgeous! I highly recommend this hotel!

name: Hampton Inn & Suites Columbus-Easton
title: “Great for Business Traveler”
text: Was in Columbus for the first time ever on a business trip in late snowy February. Have the say, the hotel was pretty much perfect. Convenient room with nice digital TV. Well appointed with plenty of pillows and one of, if not the, best shower I've ever used in a hotel. Big walk-in shower with high shower head and was HOT very quickly. Breakfast was as good as you can get for a free hotel breakfast bar, not very busy even on the mornings when the hotel was booked full. Oh and the location was great. right off highway and the only noise I heard from outside was the occasional fire siren. Hotel was not quite walking distance to the Easton center but not even a 2 minute drive. I'm certain that if I have to go back to Columbus I will be staying here.

name: Hampton Inn & Suites Columbus-Easton
title: “Great Stay!”
text: We enjoyed our stay at Hampton Inn this past weekend. Everything was great. The room was clean, quiet and comfortable, the breakfast had variety and good quality and the service was very friendly and accommodating. Pool was clean and the hot tub hot. Front desk was friendly and helpful. What more could one ask?

name: Argonaut Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel
title: “Loved the place!”
text: Just spent 3 nights at the Argonaut Hotel. If we ever get back to S.F. I would definately stay there again. I can't think of one negative complaint about the place. The room decor was awesome - loved the bed and pillows (I want those pillows!)even the leopard print bathrobes were fun! It was in really the perfect location (in my opinion) - close to the cable cars, shopping, and restaurants. The wine reception from 5 - 6 PM was nice also. Everyone was very friendly and helpful that worked there.

name: JW Marriott Indianapolis
title: “TOP OF THE LINE WINNER FOR MARRIOTT.....WOW!”
text: As Marriott Vacation Club owners, we routinely stay in Marriott resorts and use our points to stay in Marriott hotels when we travel and are always pleased. BUT....we decided to do a little Friday night getaway and stay in the new JW Marriott in downtown Indy last night. UNBELIEAVABLE! We were on the 33rd floor, top of the hotel with a perfect view of Lucas Oil Stadium (home of the Super Bowl this year) and couldn't believe the beautiful hotel's amenities. The executive lounge was all decked out for the Brickyard 400 and the buffet in the Pronto restaurant downstairs was just awesome. This is the largest JW Marriott in the world....over 1000 rooms....and we'll be back. Just spectacular! Good job Marriott!! (NOTE: $28 to park is a bit steep and no real pool to speak of)

name: JW Marriott Indianapolis
title: “Great Hotel But here are a couple of things.....”
text:
This hotel's decor was top notch. The beds and baths in the room were excellent.
The only complaint i have is that in July when it was 90+ degrees out the lobby and the elevators seemed to lack air flow...very stuffy. Also the thermostat in the room didnt seem to work but we may have just had a faulty one. 
All the amenities in this asian styled decor ladened hotel seemed to be top o the line and i would love to stay at a hotel like this anytime i traveled. definitely recommend it.

name: Hilton Fort Worth
title: “Beautiful historic hotel!”
text: A colleague and I recently had lunch at the Hilton Fort Worth and were very impressed with the hotel. Lovely and elegant without being stuffy....relaxed and refined at the same time. Service was excellent and I asked to see a guest room (though we could not stay the night) and then wished we COULD stay the night. I would love to go back when we can stay over! The food was very good and being so close to downtown Fort Worth is a big plus in my book.

name: Hilton Fort Worth
title: “Great Hotel And Love It's Classic Charm!!!”
text:
We are local and this is our 'escape' hotel. We have stayed on 2 different occasions, once being Labor Day weekend and the other was New Year's Eve. Had trouble with no hot water on the first stay but it was a beautiful, comfy and clean corner king room. Was more than compensated by hotel manager and returned for a special night out.
We love the classic charm of this hotel and the executive lounge is just wonderful. Great staff and the hotel may be a little outdated in some ways but is a treasure!!!!!
Very conveniently close to Sundance Square and many bars and restaurants.
We have already booked several upcoming stays and I would recommend ithis hotel to everybody. Plus you have to try Ruth's Chris in the hotel;)

name: Hampton Inn & Suites Columbus-Easton
title: “Great Exerince at the Hampton Inn-Easton”
text: Booked this hotel along with another couple for 2 rooms for July 4th. Visiting my brother-in-law's family for the holiday which was only 2 miles away in Gahanna. When we arrived I asked for King rooms if possible since we had booked queens sized double rooms and didn't need the extra beds since plans for having grandchildren stay with us fell through. The other couple's room was a king-size non-smoking with a beautiful glassed in shower. My husband (he smokes)and I requested smoking and when I opened the door we had received the king-size suite with sitting area for the same price I had booked through AAA for $89. What a surprise. Gorgeous new room with modern furnishings and everything smelled new and clean even though it was a smoking room. Comfortable bed and linens, bathroom (without the beautiful glass shower)that had a sensor light that lit up during the night if you had to use the bathroom without fumbling for switches or having to leave a light on all night. We also had a bird's eye view of the fire works in Gahanna from our window. What was a little strange was that we were on the 5th floor and smoking and non-smoking rooms were mixed together on the same floor. What we didn't smell was any smoke odor on the entire floor so maybe they use something special to keep the smoking rooms fresh. The breakfast was good with both hot and cold items available. Didn't get a chance to use the pool or hottub as we were involved with family activities and only use the hotel to sleep. Would definitely book again next year as this is an annual family outing over 4th of July. this hotel is close to Easton Mall and had places close by for food, gas, Sam's Club, etc. This was by far the best hotel we have ever stayed at when we visit yearly.

name: BEST WESTERN Fort Worth Inn & Suites
title: “The Place To Stay !!”
text: Had a very good lodging experience ! Staff wonderful, Rooms very nice very clean !! We were on a cross country motorcycle event and the manager even looked us up, and gave us towels to clean our bikes. Very good Motorcycle Stop !! Overall just a very good establishment and Motel !!!!!!!!!

name: Comfort Suites - Columbus / Clara St
title: “Pleasant stay in Columbus”
text:
Stayed for three nights. Hotel is located across the street from Ohio State Fairgrounds, and about a half-mile from the Ohio State Historical Society/State Archives so it's well located for genealogists and other researchers (though be sure to check the Archives website for their hours; they're only open three days a week!) Street is quiet with little traffic, just two turns away from Exit 111 of Interstate 71 southbound.
Hotel is clean, our room bright and cheerful. In addition to bed area, the room had a small seating area with a sofabed and small worktable for two. Free high-speed wired (Ethernet) access. (If you don't have a cable, the front desk will provide one for free.) Large, clean bathroom. Good selection of television channels.
Pleasant and helpful front desk staff. The lobby is nicely decorated and offers several sofas and chairs where one can meet friends. During breakfast, some of this furniture receives the overflow from the adjacent breakfast area which seats about 20. There's also a smaller balcony-like 2nd floor lobby with a large-screen television, sofa and chairs, also fine for meeting guests.
A free "deluxe continental breakfast" is offered in the lobby from 6 a.m. to 9 a.m. (times strictly observed!) Offerings include coffee, milk, juices, cereals, fruit, pastries and several hot items: Artificial or powdered egg patties (thumbs down), sausage patties and make-your-own waffles. All you can (or want to) eat, adequate and edible, not haute cuisine, but it's free and it's handy. 
As others have noted, there's only a McDonalds within walking distance of this hotel. The staff suggested travelling north on I-71 about five miles to Exit 117, which has several national chain restaurants. Subsequently we found even more options further north at Exit 121, Polaris, including a huge number of restaurants embedded in one of the most extensive chains of shopping malls we've ever seen. It's worth the ten-mile jaunt if McDonalds is not your thing. Alternatively, the front desk can direct you to the Ohio State University area (about a five-mile drive to the west) which has many restaurants and shops.
Our only question concerned room rates, which inexplicably changed from $76.45 (+ taxes) on Wednesday and Thursday to $98.95 + taxes on Friday. We asked the clerk who said the rate changes to a "weekend rate" on Thursday at midnight, but most hotels have a LOWER rate on weekends, not a higher one. Also, watch for the $1 per night charge for the room safe. We found our safe locked (by the previous occupant) upon arrival, had no use of the safe, and had the charge willingly removed from our bill by the front desk staff upon checkout. Don't know whether they will waive the charge if you don't use your safe from the start.
Generally a very pleasant experience.

name: Renaissance Columbus Downtown Hotel
title: “Very Clean Rooms, Great Staff”
text: My husband and I stayed here for the Arnold Classic 2010. This is a wonderful hotel, very clean with beautiful decor. Staff was very helpful and ready to assist. Valet was prompt and always ready. Plenty of taxi cabs waiting in the drive beside hotel which was very convenient for us. Restaurant in hotel was nice, but I also HIGHLY recommend walking just a few feet down the street to Due Amici Itaian Restaurant.....Excellent food.

name: Hilton Fort Worth
title: “Great Business Trip”
text:
Stayed recently for a business meeting.
Great room: clean, spacious, no ambient noise from other rooms, HUGE TV.
Great conference room facilities (continental room).
Dinner at Ruth Chris was spectacular (chocolate mousse was HEAVEN
Starbucks attached in the lobby!!! 
Staff was warm and friendly, breakfast buffet was good with hot fresh choices.
Will definitely stay again for a personal trip.

name: Staybridge Suites West Fort Worth
title: “Great Rooms, Amazing Service”
text: Rooms are very spacious, and very luxurious, staff is very friendly, always great you with a smile and answer any questions you have. Sundowners Reception is an amazing idea that I have never seen at any other hotel, excellent for socializing, and making your stay that much better. Pool is great, fitness room is available 24/7 as are laundry services. Everything you need not only to meet your expectations but exceed them! Exceptional experience

name: The Westin Columbus
title: “Beautiful Historic Property, Excellent Service”
text: Very comfortable beds, Service oriented friendly staff go beyond the call of duty, Beautifully appointed rooms. Only con was a little issue with thin walls.. Could hear the loud conversation of the woman staying in the room next to ours......Wish the bathtub was deeper but otherwise wonderful stay and very wonderful room! Room service was very good as was the restaurant. Loved our stay in Columbus.

name: The Donatello Hotel
title: “Excellent hôtel à SF”
text:
Nous avons séjourné 2 fois dans cet hôtel au mois de juillet et aout: c'est parfait.
Chambres spacieuses(essayez le 5ème étage, les chambres ont une terrasse très agréable), personnel discret, efficace et très réactif, localisation centrale à 1 block de Union square ( tous les transports en commun sont là), restos grands et petits à côté de l'hotel (pour un breakfast typiqmt US essayez le Pinecrest).
Bref c'était parfait.

name: JW Marriott Indianapolis
title: “Big, shiny and new but not as posh as expected”
text:
I thought the JW was to Marriott what the Conrad is to Hilton but I didn't find that to be the case. The hotel is massive and very state of the art with every bell and whistle you can buy today but I just thought it would be more plush and opulent. If you were blindfolded and put in a hotel room you would think you were at any nice upper scale full service hotel, including their full service Marriott sister hotel down the street.
Service was pretty good except for I also experienced the problem with the key system which I was ok with, even though unlike another reviewer I did not get a nice note or any sort of turndown service for my inconvenience. However there was one problem with not having a key and that was gaining true access to the workout facilities. At check-in I asked about gaining access without a key and was told just to come back to the desk and they would let me in, ok no problem, but what they didn't say was that once you are inside of the exercise complex you need a key to move around freely. Without a key I couldn't even get in the women’s locker room to use the facilities. Why the place is locked down like Fort Knox inside the exercise room I have no idea but if you have a key you probably wouldn’t notice the inconvenience. On the plus side the equipment is all state of the art and plentiful! 
Aside from the key issue and my coffee/tea amenities in my room not being replenished during my stay everything else was fine. Employees were courteous and friendly. Lobby bar has a nice atmosphere with a drink menu that is fun and creative. I highly recommend the basil lime gimlet for a refreshing treat! 
Once they work through the opening hiccups they should be fine, but I'm still not sure the value is there for the hype I’ve heard over JW’s elsewhere.

name: Red Roof Inn Columbus Downtown - Convention Center
title: “Another nice stay . . .”
text: On the last two occassions of visiting Columbus we have stayed at the Red Roof, most recently this past weekend. I have never had a problem and in fact the staff was very helpful to me and my "friend". A call for extra pillows and they were quickly brought to the room! The standard, affordable rooms in a great location let us walk to nearby bars and restaurants in the Arena District and the $10 a day parking with in/out priv. was more than reasonable for the downtown location. For the location and price a great deal.

name: Crowne Plaza Columbus Downtown
title: “Nice Stay”
text: We stayed one night here for a wedding and it was a nice stay. The bed was very comfortable and the room was clean. Check-in and check-out were both quick and easy. The elevator gave us some problems on arrival and wouldn't take us all the way to our floor (11th) so we rode up and down and finally it worked. The room service menu was from Max and Irma's which made for a really nice late night snack. The parking was pretty expensive at 21.00 per night but there was really no other option. The hotel is right across from Nationwide Arena and we had a good view of it from our window.

name: Comfort Inn North
title: “Don't stay here for anything!!!!!!”
text:
We stayed here for a wedding. Requested a room for two nights & additional room. They were over booked asked us to leave the day of the wedding. The room was dirty, found food in floor & under beds. Manager Bobbie was so rude and not helpful at all. We never received our second room. We also asked for a non-smoking room and they took out the ashtrays in this smokefilled room and called it non-smoking. 
Terrible!!!!

name: Hilton Fort Worth
title: “Nothing Works”
text: I stayed in Hilton FW one night on a business trip. It was a really bad experience. Nothing in this hotel seemed to work. The Business Center was down - no access to Internet or copy machines. I asked for some help and they sent a maintenance guy (the one that turnes up when your toilet is making a strange noise...). He was really nice but had no clue about computers. So no copies for me. I went upstairs and was not too surprised when my Internet connection did not work either. The thermostat in the room was dead. It was an unusually hot day for November - 75+ and my room was really uncomfortable, hard to breathe. The final straw was the breakfast. My oatmeal had a large piece of onion in it. I almost threw up. Disgusting. As a nice farewell note - the entire sidewalk by the entrance was covered by vomit from the night before (they had a big election day party at the hotel and didnt bother to clean it). I will never ever stay at this property again.

name: BEST WESTERN Fort Worth Inn & Suites
title: “excellent”
text:
Location: The hotel is located outside of Fort Worth but with really good access. It also has a good access to Dallas which is something like half an hour drive.
Room: We stayed in a king room which was spacious and clean and very comfortable, with a fridge and a microwave oven.
Service: Very friendly and helpful service. All our needs were met and all our questions answered with a smile.
Extras: Free basic breakfast, and free fast Wi-Fi.
Quality price ration: We booked on the hotel site and got a good deal, this is definitely a good quality hotel so I’ll give it a 9/10

name: The Donatello Hotel
title: “Parfait”
text:
Hôtel très bien situé à proximité immédiate d'Union Square. Demande pour changer de chambre après une nuit car celle-ci donnait sur rue et le soir même, nouvelle chambre "sur cour" au calme.
Personnel très aimable et disponible.
Hôtel très bien tenu et chambres (ou plutôt studio) parfaites.

name: The Ashton Hotel
title: “Excellent Place!”
text: We wanted a great get-a-way, without the drive. We chose to stay at The Ashton Hotel for our anniversary. What a great place! We will certainly go back.

name: Chancellor Hotel on Union Square
title: “Some problems”
text: I was excited to stay at the Chancellor Hotel after reading all the reviews. This hotel was certainly a bargain. We were able to get it pretty cheap from Priceline. I always wonder if we get our hotel from such a website, does that indicate we will get a bad room? We were on the top floor with no view. We saw the backs of builiding and ugly rooftops. Because we would be out of the hotel 90% of the time, I didn't mind. The front desk staff was very nice. The door man helped us with our bags and was very courteous. The hotel doesn't need A/C. It was freezing in the middle of July and the fan does a fine job cooling you down. With the windows open, however, you do hear garbage trucks and a lot of noise from the city (trolleys gear up around 6 or 7 am). We stopped downstairs to try to figure out how to get a trolley pass and we quickly found the reservation desk. The woman behind the reservation desk was unreal. I have never experienced such behavior. She was taking a personal call while we were standing in front of her. She actually put her hand over the phone and asked us what we needed, gave us a short answer and then went back to talking on the phone. It was something you would see in a sitcom. My husband got out money for a trolley pass and he stood there with the money out for over a minute while we listened to her telephone conversation. So, we didn't get the great treatment that it appears other reviewers received. The trolleys were always full and after buying a 3-day pass to use them, we were very upset that we ended up walking the majority of the time. We found out later that if we would have walked 2 blocks we would be picked up without a problem (this is something the reservation desk should have told us) Parking is around $30.00 plus tax a day, which is another expenditure you will need to budget in. We also had a problem with someone trying to get into our room around midnight on our second night. I was happy to be checking out the next day and moving onto Napa Valley where it was quieter, where you don't need to pay for parking and everyone was very accomidating.

name: The Ashton Hotel
title: “The Ashton Staff was GREAT!”
text: Wonderful hotel. Beautiful big rooms with very comfortable beds and gorgeous bathrooms. I was especially impressed with the friendly staff and all their help. They were more than willing to go the extra mile to make the stay a success!

name: Argonaut Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel
title: “Ottimo”
text: Ho soggiornato all'Argonaut per 3 notti durante il mio viaggio di nozze. Camere spaziose (vista Golden Gate), staff gentile e disponibile, posizione perfetta (al capolinea della cable car Powell - Hyde e a pochi passi dal Pier 39). Lo consiglio vivamente!

name: Chancellor Hotel on Union Square
title: “Hotel with Character”
text:
We arrived in SF tired from a long plane ride and it was great to
arrive at a Hotel that made you feel at home. The Bellman Rienaldo
was real nice and remembered us throughout our stay. The Restaurant
was also very good. We ate at Sears Fine foods next door and had a good
meal but the hotel restaurant was just as good! Our room was small but
had the character of a European Hotel.

name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Columbus West - Hilliard
title: “Excellent Stay all around! We'll stay here every time in Columbus!”
text: In town to see an incredible funk band (the Hoodoo Soul Band) on a Sunday night and a visit to the Columbus Zoo the next day. Stayed two nights -- excellent service, clean, comfortable room. Huge room! Quiet hotel. Nice, clean pool although we didn't swim. Good location near many restaurants and shopping, some within walking distance. My only disappointment, as with most LaQuintas, was the breakfast variety. I hate hard boiled eggs and don't really do waffles and that was about the extent of the offering. Would love to see the chain "up" their breakfast bar.

name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Columbus Airport
title: “clean and new”
text: This hotel had a very accommodating person at check-in when I got there very late. The room was very clean and roomy and had wide screen TV's and all the extras you would want.

name: Hilton Garden Inn Columbus/Polaris
title: “Good location on the northeast side of town”
text: Hotel design is typical of the Hilton Garden Inn chain - clean, friendly, efficient. Only wish the weight room was better furnished - no exercise bikes. Close to a big mall, lots of restaurants around the area. Somewhat limited on TV channels - no History Channel!

name: Baymont Inn and Suites Columbus at Rickenbacker
title: “Stayed 18 hours had to pay for 2 days!”
text: OTR truck driver - wanted a night out of the truck. Didn't check in until 11:30 PM by the time I finally found the hotel. Not convient location. Price was ok,. Didn't have to leave until 6 PM following day. Inquired re late check out. Told could stay until 1 PM. Also total 1/2 day would be 1/2 of price paid for room. Desk cleark said check out was 2:00. Told him 'oh won't be their anywhere that long. A half day until 2 AM very generous - right? WRONG! At 2:59 PM received call saying check out was 2 PM. So 1 hour would have cost me 1/2 price of the room! By then too late to change plans so ended up paying for 2 whole nights. Clerk was very aware that he didn't explain this. Got me this time but will never stay at Baymony again. Dislike crooks.

name: Hilton Columbus at Easton
title: “Great Hotel , Great Restaurant”
text: Very friendly.accomodating staff. Very good food. had a cream of Lentils soup and and a Steak beautifully preparred

name: The Westin Columbus
title: “Wonderful bedding”
text: Our stay, while short, was excellent. All staff members were helpful and extremely accommodating and we were impressed with the cleanliness and comfort of the rooms. From crystal clear plasma screens to thoughtful room amenities to bedding that was downright heavenly, we loved it all! While we never saw this hotel before their renovation, we can attest to the success! Kudos to the staff and management for a job well done!

name: Omni Fort Worth Hotel
title: “Overcrowded and Overpriced”
text: There was a convention leaving on Friday and the hotel was ridiculously packed. Just to get the elevator was like a 10 minute wait and a 20 minute wait for the valet, THEN on Saturday there was a big wedding and a million people were there and AGAIN there was a long wait for the elevator and the valet. The bottled water was SOLD OUT on the ONLY vending machine on the floor and the only other alternative was ordering room service. The internet required a password which I didn't even bother calling to get because I was afraid that I would have to pay for that too OH and the Valet is NOT included.

name: Worthington Red Roof Inn
title: “Good for the money”
text: Priced at $40, this hotel is worth it. It is clean, pleasant staff, and good location. No frills but a nice place to sleep for the night.

name: Four Points by Sheraton Columbus Ohio Airport
title: “Overall very good, a few issues”

name: Cambria Suites
title: “Pleasant Surprise”
text:
I had not previously stayed at the brand but was very pleasantly surprised. The facility as well as the rooms were very clean, modern and comfortable. The roomm was roomy with many amenetes.
The staff was very pleasant and helpful

name: Fort Rapids Indoor Waterpark Resort
title: “Pleasantly Surprised”
text:
After reading a few previous reviews of this hotel/resort, we were hesitant to follow through with our plans there June 9th-10th.
However, we are now glad we followed through as our stay was a pleasant one.
Fort Rapids is conveniently located just of I-70 near the I-270 beltway. You can see the building from the freeway. However, access from Hamilton Ave. was not marked and was a guessing game the first time in. Once there, we were impressed with the imaculate landscaping on the exterior grounds. We arrived around the 4PM check-in (a 2PM check-in was available with Holiday Inn club membership). There was no waiting and we were immediately checked in by a very courteous staff.
The interior of the resort was decorated appropriately in a western theme. Our room (Cisco the Kid) included a King bed and a set of bunks enclosed in a "fort". The room was clean and everything worked as expected. This was important as we traveled with two 12 year olds and a 10 month old baby.
The bunks included a plasma tv that the 12's loved. One of the three elevators at the tower was out of order but there was never a long wait for the other two. 
The waterpark itself was very nice with plenty to do for everyone.
There were plenty of other amenities on the property as well as a nice restaruant, bar and gift shop.
There is an abundance of restaurants on Hamilton Ave. just a block away from the resort. There is a mall and stores just a short distance to the south. In conclusion, our stay was pleasant and above expectations. Almost Disneylike. I'm assuming most of the problems experienced by other reviewers here happened when the hotel was at or near capacity and the staff was taxed. The resort was busy but not crowded during our stay on a weekend in June.
Hope everyone's stay is as good as ours.

name: SpringHill Suites El Paso
title: “A First Rate Hotel With Character”
text: We have stayed at SpringHill Suites many times en route to Palm Springs for the winter and then on our return to Minnesota. This hotel is located in the best section of the El Paso area and has great rooms, service, and food. We like it because it is only 3 minutes from Highway 10, yet is quiet and nicely decorated. Actually, it is better than some of the Courtyard by Marriott's we have stayed at. Must book a few days in advance because it is a 4 story hotel and frequented by the business community. John and Mona Moede

name: Hyatt Place El Paso Airport
title: “Hyatt Place ELP”
text:
I stayed here with my boyfriend for 5 nights, then turning into 6 as I missed my flight back to London. This was during the Thanksgiving period which I was there for.
The rooms are exactly the same at any Hyatt Place. Comfy beds, plenty of room, though the bathroom is small, it wasn't that bad.
The downside was, there are no microwaves in the rooms. A fridge, yes, but the microwave no. However, you can ask the staff to warm up food in their microwave.
The view we had was great. Though you can see I-10, you can also see the lovely view of the mountains.
The night we stayed when I missed my flight, the room had a musty smell. But the previous room.we had was ok.
All in all, I love the Hyatt Place and the staff are great!

name: Days Inn El Paso
title: “NO CUSTOMER SERVICE AT FRONT DESK”
text: Arrived before check in time and needed two nights. Front desk clerk rudely made me aware she wouldn't check me in or accept a reservation until after2pm. Needless to say, my husband I found another hotel that appreciated our business and gave us a nice clean room For a great price. LA QUINTA.

name: Omni Fort Worth Hotel
title: “Gorgeous new hotel, outstanding customer service, this place has it all!”
text: Last year I heard this hotel had just opened downtown Fort Worth (we live in Dallas) and was getting rave reviews. I surprised my husband for his birthday and booked a room for the night. We loved it so much last year, we decided to return this year for his birthday again. I spoke with both a reservations agent and the concierge beforehand, informing them of our special occasion. Upon our arrival, we found our room to have been enormously upgraded, to a stunning, huge suite on the 10th floor. This room was absolutely incredible- dining room, living room, study, separate bedroom, TWO immaculate bathrooms, and a wraparound glass balcony with a great view of the rooftop pool (which is also a GEM!). Waiting for us was chocolate birthday cake and a chilled bottle of champagne. At bedtime, someone came in and turned down our bed, dimmed the lights, put flower petals on the bed, and left us a breakfast menu. I did not pay A PENNY EXTRA for any of this! The Omni employees took such good care of us last year, and somehow managed to outdo themselves this year. We will be back any chance we get!

name: Argonaut Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel
title: “tres bel hotel attention au valet 198 dollars 3 nuits”
text:
tres très bel hotel très bien situé
prestation impeccable
attention aux chambres du 2ème qui sont au niveau du trotoir, car la route monte
MAIS ATTENTION VALET. Déposer vos bagages et chercher un parking qui ne sont valables que 24 heures, il faut donc sortir et rentrer, mais l'économie est tès conséquente ! 
Connaissant cet astuce j'y retournerais sans problème
dominique

name: Doubletree Hotel El Paso Downtown/City Center
title: “Clean and modern”
text: I stayed at this hotel for a work conference in November 2012. It was clean and nice, but in a location that doesn't really have a lot going on around it. I was shocked to walk around at night and not see hardly a single car or person. So it was perfect for work, not perfect if you're visiting El Paso as a tourist.

name: Super 8 El paso Airport
title: “outstanding visit”
text: i had the best time staying here at BW elpaso,my truck broke down and the staff picked me up, and made sure i was comfortable,with the shuttle and room,,Rohit was very helpfull in assuring i was happy,,,way to go

name: Ramada Suites El Paso
title: “Very Nice.”
text: This hotel is all suites. Very nice rooms, doesn't take too long to travel to any place in El Paso. Very helpful and good prices.

name: La Quinta Inn & Suites El Paso East
title: “El Paso trip”
text: Although our stay was one night, our experience at this property was very good. The only negative was barking dogs on our floor, which was swiftly addressed by the security staff. As a result, this property should reconsider their pet policy. Otherwise, we would recommend to others and would definitely stay here again!

name: Hampton Inn El Paso-Airport
title: “A Great Place To Kick Back After A Long Day At The Office”
text: I spent three nights here on a business trip back in April. The staff at the hotel were friendly, the continental breakfast was amazing, and the nightly manager's reception was a nice touch. This hotel helped to make my business trip relaxing. The location was convenient as there was many great restaurants in the area and it was a 5 minute drive to the airport.

name: Hyatt Place El Paso Airport
title: “What a beautiful room!”
text:
The guestroom is probably the best I have ever been. And yes, I have been to 4-star hotels. The room has a HUGE 42" LCD TV--I can't believe that when I stepped in. The configuration of the room is so good, just so good. All furnitures are new and elegant. The room is fairly big, with two sections partially seperated by a wall. There is a study desk and kitechen too. I love this place!
The only thing that made me a little uncomfortable is that, because I bid trough priceline, they lied to me on the phone that they did not have rooms left with a king-sized bed. The old lady at the front desk, however, was nice and gave me a king. :)

name: Chancellor Hotel on Union Square
title: “very poor service avoid”
text:
Our room was entered and some shopping stolen. They showed us the room key read out which showed a key the same as ours had been used to gain entrance at a time we weren't at the hotel. They clearly have a security problem, someone can copy their keys. Either that or I stole my own shopping
!!
Stay somewhere else, anywhere else.

name: Hilton Columbus at Easton
title: “Great we highly recommend!”
text:
VERY NICE.... Hotel! 
Extremely convenient to amazing shops and resturants Just walk accross the street!
We stayed on concierge level well worth the extra money!
Free soda, water and Starbucks....Continental Breakfast ....Nice Hors D' Hoerves at Night!
The Zoo in Columbus is GREAT also!
We look Forward to staying there again!

name: Wyndham El Paso Airport
title: “Great Stay”
text: I really enjoyed my stay at the Wyndham. Everyone was very nice and helpful. I loved the hotel with the courtyard so close to the airport. A real resort feel. I will be staying here every time I visit El Paso. I travel for my work and I can honestly say this is one place that made me really feel like home.

name: Omni Fort Worth Hotel
title: “Excellent hotel for the Ft. Worth Convention Center”
text:
Closest I have ever stayed to a convention center. Hotel was a little austere for my taste but it was following the "cowboy" theme thru out. The room was well appointed, very clean and spacious. Excellent bed and comfortable bedding. There was a small refrigerator provided (with water) but that was it. (Had a coffee maker) Room was very quiet (5th floor). 
Had dinner at both restaurants in the hotel (Bob's and I forget the other). All food and service was superb. The Wine Thief Bar was excellent. They had a really, really good tapas-style menu that alot of people took advantage of. Their pours were generous and the service, again, was top notch. Room service was better than I've had at most places.
The clientele was mostly people attending conventions or venues across the street at the convention center. They seemed to have addressed the valet problem when we were there.
